item.title: 판매 200만 장 돌파한 '프래그마타', 다이애나의 특별한 그림 공개
item.content:encoded: 캡콤의 신작 게임 프래그마타가 지난 4월 17일 출시된 이후 약 3주 만에 글로벌 누적 판매량 200만 장을 돌파하는 쾌거를 달성했습니다. 7일 캡콤은 공식 SNS를 통해 이 소식을 알리며 조용희 디렉터의 감사 인사와 함께 기념 일러스트를 공개했습니다. 조 디렉터는 플레이어들의 성원에 감사를 표했으며, 다이애나가 직접 그림을 전하는 영상도 함께 선보였습니다. 뛰어난 게임성으로 호평받는 프래그마타는 앞으로도 높은 인기를 이어갈 전망입니다.

item.title: 서바이벌 호러로 돌아오는 '싱킹 시티2', 26년 여름 출시
item.content:encoded: 프로그웨어가 7일 신작 ‘싱킹 시티2’ 트레일러를 공개했다. 1920년대 아캄을 배경으로 한 서바이벌 호러 게임으로, 주인공 칼빈 래퍼티가 연인을 구하려 사투를 벌이는 과정을 담았다. 수사 중심에서 호러와 생존에 비중을 둔 변화가 특징이며, 오는 2026년 여름 PC, PS5, XSX|S 플랫폼을 통해 정식 출시될 예정이다.

item.content:encoded: 2026년 3월 24일 디즈니+에서 공개되는 ‘데어데블 본 어게인’ 시즌2는 넷플릭스 시리즈의 캐릭터성을 완벽히 부활시켰다. 시장이 된 킹핀의 공포 정치와 이에 맞서는 맷 머독의 대립을 치밀한 정치극으로 그려냈으며, 속죄와 자비라는 주제를 통해 극의 완성도를 높였다. 이는 향후 이어질 퍼니셔와 스파이더맨 관련 작품에 대한 기대감을 크게 끌어올리는 수작이다.

[정보] 여름 쇼케이스 '오버드라이브' 6월 13일(토) 개최! MAPLE NOW
item.content:encoded: 메이플스토리가 6월 13일 16시 여름 쇼케이스 'OVERDRIVE'를 개최하며, 5월 26일 20시부터 티켓 예매를 시작합니다. 주요 업데이트로 신규 보스 '진'과 '리버스 차원의 탑'이 추가되며, 썸머 카운트다운을 통해 솔 에르다 조각 300개를 제공합니다. 또한 롯데월드타워 오프라인 행사와 6월 14일 극장판 애니메이션 '디어 마이 히어로' 개봉 등 풍성한 즐길 거리를 예고했습니다. 펀치킹 시즌4와 초능력 윷놀이 등 다양한 이벤트도 함께 진행될 예정입니다.

item.title: [Ent+] HBO '해리 포터' 시리즈, 시즌2 올 가을부터 촬영 시작
item.content:encoded: HBO가 해리 포터 드라마 시리즈의 시즌2 제작을 공식 확정했습니다. 이번 시즌은 '해리 포터와 비밀의 방'을 다룰 예정이며, 올해 가을부터 본격적인 촬영에 돌입합니다. 존 브라운과 프란체스카 가디너가 공동 프로듀서를 맡아 제작을 이끌 계획입니다. 한편, 시리즈의 첫 번째 작품인 '해리 포터와 마법사의 돌'은 올해 12월 25일 HBO 맥스를 통해 공개되며 한국은 쿠팡플레이에서 독점 방영될 예정입니다.

item.title: 카카오게임즈 '크로노 오디세이' 신규 성장 시스템 소개하는 5차 개발자 노트 공개
[컨콜] 넷마블, 26년 하반기 '프로젝트 이지스' 포함 신작 5종 출시한다
item.content:encoded: 넷마블은 2026년 5월 7일 1분기 매출 6,517억 원, 영업이익 531억 원을 기록했다고 발표했다. 신작 출시와 자산 매각으로 수익이 개선됐으며 5월 14일 PC, 21일 모바일로 ‘왕좌의 게임: 킹스로드’를 아시아에 출시한다. 연내 ‘SOL: 인챈트’와 하반기 신작 4종, 프로젝트 이지스 등 해외 자회사 신작을 통해 글로벌 공략에 박차를 가한다.

item.title: 포가튼 사가가 30년만에 돌아온다
item.content:encoded: 대원미디어가 손노리의 고전 명작 RPG 포가튼 사가의 부활을 예고하며 공식 유튜브를 통해 티저 영상을 공개했습니다. 1997년 출시 당시 수많은 버그에도 독보적인 자유도와 매력으로 사랑받았던 이 게임은 대원미디어의 손을 거쳐 새롭게 탄생할 예정입니다. 포가튼 사가의 구체적인 정보는 2026년 5월 21일 킨텍스에서 개막하는 플레이엑스포를 통해 최초로 공개될 예정이며, 많은 팬들의 기대가 모이고 있습니다.

item.title: 하스스톤 35.4 패치 업데이트, 첫 직업 세트 '아제로스의 복원' 출시
item.content:encoded: 하스스톤이 35.4 패치를 통해 첫 직업 세트 ‘아제로스의 복원’을 공개했다. 이번 세트는 드루이드, 사냥꾼, 성기사, 마법사 4개 직업에 특화된 강력한 카드를 선보이며 각 직업별 고유한 복원 전략을 제공한다. 직업 세트는 연간 3회에 걸쳐 4개씩 출시될 예정이며, 올해 확장팩 출시 이후에도 새로운 직업 세트 4개가 추가 출시될 예정이다.

TV Anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo Opening Theme Song “Komorebizaka”, by Galileo Galilei, CD Single Announcement and Jacket Illustration Reveal!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="booklove-anime.jp" url="booklove-anime.jp" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo began airing April 9, 2026. The manga was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine Gessan and has since won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, been ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia. This fateful encounter triggers a gradual change within his household.
  • It has been announced that “Komorebizaka” by Galileo Galilei, the opening theme song, will be released as a single. The titular track was written specifically to serve as the opening theme song for the anime after a heartfelt request by the author Akira Konno. In conclusion, a miraculous song was born from the mutual respect between Galileo Galilei and the author. In addition, the tracklist for the CD single, which includes the anime insert song “Hito wa Wataridori”, has also been revealed.
  • The CD jacket illustration is an original illustration by the author. It features Kujima standing alone amidst the swaying grass by the water’s edge as migrating birds fly across the sky. This one-of-a-kind illustration perfectly captures the beautiful and emotional atmosphere of the music. You don’t want to miss out on this rare piece from Galileo Galilei and Akira Konno.
    • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ETgAcnUcro

    Product Information

    Komorebizaka by Galileo Galilei Date: June 24, 2026 Price: 1,320 yen (tax in.) / VTCL-35394 Tracklist 1. Komorebizaka 2. Hito wa Wataridori 3. Komorebizaka -Instrumental- 4. Hito wa Wataridori -Instrumental-

    About Galileo Galilei

    Yuuki Ozaki (vocals, guitar) and Kazuki Ozaki (drums) formed the rock band in 2007 in Wakkanai, Hokkaido. In 2008, they won the Senko Riot grand prix and made their major debut in 2010 with their first mini album Hamanasu no Hana. Their transparent melodies and delicate lyrics have gathered support from fans around the world. After their debut, they released numerous hits such as “Natsuzora” (OP theme song for Big Windup! 2) and “Aoi Shiori” (OP theme song for Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw). Following their concert at the Nippon Budokan in 2016, they went on hiatus but have since resumed activities as of October 2022 with a new lineup featuring Yuuki Ozaki, Kazuki Ozaki, Masaki Okazaki (bass) and original founding member Fumito Iwai (guitar). On March 15, 2025, they held a concert at Tokyo Garden Theatre celebrating their 15th anniversary. On October 11, 2025, the guitarist DAIKI, who had been an active member in Bird Bear Hare and Fish (BBHF) alongside Yuuki and Kazuki and had served as a support guitarist for Galileo Galilei, officially joined the band. They released “Amadeus”, the OP theme song for TV anime Ao no Orchestra Season 2, that same month. Galileo Galilei Tour 2026 NAKED HERO, their nationwide tour taking them across seven cities in Japan, kicks off in May 2026. Official Website: galileogalilei.jp Official YouTube: youtube.com/@GalileoGalileiOfficial X Account: x.com/galileo_news Instagram: instagram.com/galileogalileiphoto TikTok: tiktok.com/@gg_galileo

item.title: TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo Original Soundtrack Hororo Shoyo, composed by Manami Kakudo, to be released!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="booklove-anime.jp" url="booklove-anime.jp" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo began airing April 9, 2026. The manga was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine Gessan and has since won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, been ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia. This fateful encounter triggers a gradual change within his household.
  • The original soundtrack album compiling the series’ distinctive yet mysteriously nostalgic musical score will be released on June 24 and composed by musician and percussionist Manami Kakudo. This marks her first TV anime soundtrack release. Born from her rich talent and avant-garde ideas, her sounds are bold and seamless. She effortlessly crosses the boundaries of classical, ambient, folk, jazz and contemporary genres with her own performance using a variety of instruments including marimba, percussion, piano, and flute. Her extraordinary talent is on full display with this 40-track album. “Hororo Shoyo”, the ending theme for the series, was released earlier and will be included in the soundtrack. This album is more than an original soundtrack, but a collection that showcases the rich and diverse musicality of Manami Kakudo.

In 2020, she made her major debut as a solo artist with her first album oar. In 2024, she released her second album Contact. She’s earned the trust of many unique artists through supporting their activities outside of her solo career, such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. Who Are Mrs. GREEN APPLE and Why is Their Album 10 Making Waves Worldwide?
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Mrs. GREEN APPLE (MGA) ranked No. 13 on the IFPI Global Artist Chart 2025, becoming the only Japanese band to make this year’s list. This follows the recent announcement that their greatest hits album 10 placed No. 10 on the IFPI Global Album Chart 2025.
  • The IFPI Global Charts compile streaming, download, and physical sales data from more than 8,000 participating record companies worldwide to create global rankings of the world’s best-selling artists and albums. MGA’s placement on both charts, alongside many of the world’s most renowned artists, has drawn significant international attention.

    • What Makes MGA So Compelling?

    Lyrics That Resonate With Everyday Life MGA’s songs reach the hearts of people facing hardship, gently encouraging them to keep moving forward. Rather than giving one-sided advice, the lyrics speak from the same perspective as the listener. Their careful choice of words and warmth feel perfectly attuned to today’s times. https://youtu.be/CO0Eoj9aPcs Darling Winner of 67th Japan Record Awards Theme song of Mrs. GREEN APPLE 18Fes The Unique Expressive Power of Vocalist Motoki Ohmori Motoki Ohmori writes, composes, and arranges all of MGA’s songs, while also overseeing every creative aspect of their work, from artwork to music video concepts. His singing, widely praised by industry professionals, effortlessly navigates complex key changes while seamlessly shifting between chest voice, head voice, mixed voice, and falsetto. Combined with the lyrics he crafts, his voice delivers a powerful emotional impact. https://youtu.be/v44zuSMBVNI Heaven Theme song of #IWillTellYoutheTruth A Diverse Musical Style Unbound by Rock Band Conventions Although they perform as a band, their artistry transcends traditional boundaries. Their free-ranging musical style is matched by a striking visual identity, including bold makeup and costumes. From dynamic dance performances in music videos to concerts featuring theatrical elements and elaborate stage production, their work elevates live entertainment to a spectacular level. https://youtu.be/v44zuSMBVNI GOOD DAY - LIVE “BABEL no TOH” 2025 December Edit Concert video https://youtu.be/-zsYJTSw_V0 breakfast Theme song of Fuji TV’s news information program Sun! Shine A Strong Affinity With Anime Collaborations Many of their songs are created as tie-ins, particularly with anime, where their music demonstrates exceptional compatibility. These collaborations often generate a powerful synergy, enhancing both the songs and the anime they accompany. https://youtu.be/MjeiIal1ZR0 lulu. Opening theme of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End season 2

    About the Greatest Hits Album 10

    The greatest hits album 10 is the band’s second greatest hits album, released on July 8, 2025. Featuring songs from their Phase 2 era onward, the 19-track collection includes signature hits such as “Que Sera Sera,” “Lilac,” and “Darling.” It is a comprehensive showcase of the band’s musical range and diversity Find it on Spotify and Apple Music. Over the ten years since their debut, MGA have released an extraordinary range of music, growing into a band that transcends the conventional boundaries of rock and J-pop. Public Playlists on Streaming Services: This is Mrs. GREEN APPLE and Hajimete no Mrs. GREEN APPLE.

    About Mrs. GREEN APPLE

    Motoki Ohmori (Vo/Gt) instagram.com/motoki_ohmori_mga Hiroto Wakai (Gt) instagram.com/hiloto_wakai_mga Ryoka Fujisawa (Key) instagram.com/ryoka_fujisawa_mga Mrs. GREEN APPLE (MGA) is a three-member band consisting of Motoki Ohmori (vocals/guitar), Hiroto Wakai (guitar), and Ryoka Fujisawa (keyboard). Formed in 2013, Mrs. GREEN APPLE made their major debut in 2015 with the mini-album Variety via EMI Records. In July 2020, they released their first greatest hits album, 5, to mark their 5th anniversary, then temporarily suspended activities. Following a hiatus of about 20 months, they resumed activities in March 2022. The period from March 2022 to December 2025, known as “Phase 2,” saw the band release 37 songs, an unusually high number for just three years and ten months. They made history by being the first artist in J-pop history to surpass 16 billion total streams across their catalog (according to Billboard Japan). To mark their 10th anniversary in 2025, they released their second greatest hits album, 10, which ranked No. 10 on the IFPI Global Album Chart 2025 and has sold over 1 million copies. In the Oricon Annual Ranking 2025, they placed 10 songs in the Top 20 of the Streaming Ranking, setting a record for the most entries in the chart’s history. They also achieved an unprecedented three consecutive wins at the Japan Record Awards and closed NHK’s national year-end program, Kohaku Uta Gassen, establishing themselves as one of Japan’s leading acts. A new song, “Kaze to Machi,” is scheduled for digital release in April 2026, with a new original full-length album, their first in about three years, planned for fall 2026. Official Website new.mrsgreenapple.com Official YouTube youtube.com/@MrsGREENAPPLE_Official/videos Official Twitter twitter.com/AORINGOHUZIN Official Instagram instagram.com/mgaband Official TikTok tiktok.com/@mga_band_official Official Facebook facebook.com/Mrs.GREENAPPLEofficial

MyAnimeList Unveils 78 Fan-Selected Titles in “You Should Read This Manga 2026”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • MyAnimeList has unveiled the final lineup for the fourth annual “You Should Read This Manga 2026,” a fan-driven manga recommendation project designed to spotlight standout titles and help readers discover what to read next.
  • This year’s selection was curated from 12,333 nominations submitted by 2,927 users, spanning 1,077 distinct manga titles. The final lineup features 78 unique manga titles selected across four discovery categories.
  • The project aims to connect readers with manga that deserve broader recognition, while creating new opportunities for discovery across a wide range of genres, styles, and reading experiences.
  • As part of the campaign, MyAnimeList users who read two volumes of any title from the 2026 list during the campaign period will earn a time-limited profile badge. The campaign will run through May 31, 2026.

    • About “You Should Read This Manga 2025”?

    “You Should Read This Manga” is a global manga promotion initiative by MyAnimeList that highlights notable titles through a combination of international user nominations and editorial curation. The project enables fans worldwide to recommend up to 10 titles and share why each work deserves recognition, resulting in a list shaped by both reader enthusiasm and qualitative input.

    “You Should Read This Manga 2026” Categories

    You Should Read This Manga 2026 For manga that readers most strongly want to recommend to others. (e.g. Magical Girl Dandelion, Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life) Should Be Anime For manga that fans especially want to see adapted into anime. (e.g. Learning to Love My Cat-like Classmate, Rai Rai Rai) Best for Beginners For readers newer to manga, including accessible and highly approachable titles. (e.g. On and Off: Work-Life Imbalance, Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun, Hirayasumi) Unique Art/Story For manga with especially distinctive artwork, storytelling, or creative identity. (e.g. Parashoppers, Gene Bride) Explore the full list: myanimelist.net/readthismanga/2026

    Trends from This Year’s List

    Demographic Balance Fan-voters have the option to select their gender when nominating, and this information is used to curate each category with a balanced list of titles that will appeal to all voters. While half of the selected titles were originally published in shounen or seinen magazines, notably one in four of these titles received more votes from female and non-binary readers. Breakout Titles From the top-voted titles, fan nominations for Gachiakuta, Ichi the Witch, and Tower Dungeon showed remarkable growth, with total nominations increasing by more than three-fold. Newly eligible titles Love Bullet and Phantom Busters also had a significant number of nominations, despite only one and two volumes being available in English, respectively. Titles Not Released in English Of 78 unique titles, eight titles have yet to be released in English. Two of these titles (Studio Cabana and Kemutai Hanashi) have been published in at least four languages (French, German, Italian, Spanish). Four of these titles have only been published in French. English Simulpub Nearly half of the titles released in English have new chapters that are published simultaneously with Japan (30/70 titles), and half of these are simulpubbed by Manga PLUS (16/70 titles). Anime Demand Two-fifths (40%) of the "Should Be Anime" list is available on Manga PLUS, half of which (20%) run in Weekly Shounen Jump magazine. Digital Origins Approximately 25% of the titles come from web-based manga platforms such as Shonen Jump+ instead of physical manga magazines. Third Year Finalists Due to high fan engagement, five titles were featured on the list for their third and final year: Gachiakuta, Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You, Gokurakugai, Hirayasumi, and Magus of the Library. For 2027's edition, these manga will be retired from the eligible titles. Previously retired titles include: Dandadan, The Summer Hikaru Died, and Witch Hat Atelier. Additional Content The project also features bonus recommendation sections created in collaboration with manga publishers and booksellers: Publisher & Bookseller Picks myanimelist.net/readthismanga/2026/publisher-bookseller-picks

    About MyAnimeList

    MyAnimeList is an anime and manga community featuring comprehensive databases maintained by its global user base. The platform allows users to track progress, rate and review titles, and discover new works through community-driven features. With over 20 million users across more than 240 countries and territories, MyAnimeList is one of the world’s largest anime and manga communities. Figures as of March 2026. For more about MyAnimeList, please visit myanimelist.net.

item.title: [리뷰] 한국 프로야구 같은 'MLB 더 쇼 26'
VTuber Unit “BY THE BEAT” Announces New Original Song “Double Vision”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • UNIVERSAL MUSIC LLC and its Japanese-music-focused label Virgin Music, announces a partnership with ANYCOLOR Inc. Together, the two companies will train and produce music for “BY THE BEAT”,a four-member VTuber unit from NIJISANJI EN, the English-speaking branch of ANYCOLOR Inc.
  • As of today, BY THE BEAT embarks upon the road to their major label debut scheduled for 2027. With the release of “Double Vision”, BY THE BEAT takes their first step toward realizing this dream. This track, composed with the idea of comparing their fans, who are indispensable to the members' activities, to “chromatic aberration” (color distortion) is an ambitious piece that blends bouncy electro-house rhythms with rap and vocal chops. The result is a cool, elegant dance track where you can almost feel the very breath of the four members.
  • The production team features Lauren Kaori, who writes songs primarily for J-POP and K-POP acts such as INI and &TEAM; MONJOE, the vocalist and synthesizer player for DATS who has recently been producing and writing songs for artists like BE:FIRST and Number_i, as well as composing music for commercials; and R&B artist, singer-songwriter LOAR, who has provided songs for artists such as Kento Nakajima and BE:FIRST.
  • BY THE BEAT just had a special collab program on their official YouTube channel to commemorate the occasion, and the “Double Vision” music video is now available for streaming!
    • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tGYLtyakmlM

    Comments from the members of BY THE BEAT

    Zeal Ginjoka Hey there! I'm Zeal Ginjoka, BY THE BEAT's resident mixer of drinks and beats. I'm super excited to start this new journey with everyone! The four of us are working incredibly hard to bring fun songs to all of our wonderful HzBeats. Be sure to keep an eye on us, okay? There's a vibrant journey ahead!! Freodore Hey everyone. I'm Freodore, designer of BY THE BEAT. Soon you'll be able to watch over us as we continue to hone our skills and make the most out of this new venture. We're committed to doing our best to release a lot of fashionable music, so I hope we can be under your care! Seible Nyao! My name's Seible, promoter of BY THE BEAT! Let's paint the skies with song and dance, joy and laughter! Join us as we dive into late-night recordings, heartfelt sessions, and exciting rehearsals to bring song and smile to your lips. Will you be the melody to my music? Kaelix Debonair Ya—ho! Kaelix Debonair; charmed, I'm sure! I'm the bouncer of BY THE BEAT. I've always enjoyed singing live, but I'm excited (and nervous) to venture into recording for original music! I'm really thankful to share in this opportunity with my dear friends, so I'll do my best from here on out. Won't you sing along? With the release of their first single “Double Vision”, BY THE BEAT embarks on their major global debut with Universal Music. Please look forward to their future activities.

    Streaming Information

    1st Digital Single “Double Vision” Streaming date: March 29 12:00 p.m. JST List of streaming platforms: BY-THE-BEAT.lnk.to/DoubleVisionPR Music Video: youtube.com/watch?v=tGYLtyakmlM

    "BY THE BEAT" is a group consisting of NIJISANJI EN Livers Zeal Ginjoka, Freodore, Seible, and Kaelix Debonair. They are on a mission to share their music with the world.

item.content:encoded:

  • Shiro Sagisu, a composer, arranger, music producer, and conductor known for his work on titles such as Evangelion, Bleach, Shin Godzilla, and Shin Ultraman, released two albums simultaneously on March 25, 2026, as part of his new THE WHITE ALBUM series: THE WHITE ALBUM 1 EVANGELION 30TH ANNIVERSARY and THE WHITE ALBUM 2 EVANGELION 30TH ANNIVERSARY.
  • Led by Sagisu himself, the THE WHITE ALBUM series reimagines beloved tracks with orchestral arrangements and other new elements, vividly rekindling the memories of the stories they accompany while breathing new life into the music. The series also includes rare, previously unreleased recordings, letting listeners fully experience the expansive worlds of these works.

item.title: [리뷰] ‘제로 ~붉은 나비~ 리메이크’, 귀신도 예뻐~
[Honey's Anime Interview] PassCode is Overcoming Weakness and Rewriting Fate with "Liberator," Their Latest Song
item.content:encoded:
PassCode continues to redefine the boundaries of music, blending high-energy electronic sounds with heavy metal intensity and explosive vocals. Originally rooted in a more traditional idol style, the group has evolved into a genre-defying act, incorporating a wide range of influences while maintaining their signature edge. With their latest track, “Liberator,” PassCode taps into a darker, more emotional direction inspired by the anime Roll Over and Die. And as they head into their 10th anniversary in 2026, the group shows no signs of slowing down. Dive into our interview with PassCode below!

Nao
Kaede
Hinako
Emily
Interview with PassCode
[gray-hex-decoration]
Thank you for speaking with us once again! But for those who are just discovering PassCode, could you tell us a bit about the group—how it started and what kind of music you create?
At the very beginning, our sound was what you’d typically expect from an idol group. Around that time, more idols were starting to incorporate metal and screams, and our music gradually shifted into the style we have now. While our sound is rooted in metal, we also incorporate a lot of different elements. Emily Arima’s screams are especially distinctive.
For your latest song “Liberator”, during the songwriting process, was there a particular mood, theme, or message you wanted to convey?
I hope the song can convey things like striving to become stronger to protect something important, and being reminded of the true value of the connections between people.
https://youtu.be/TgSG9VxKI-I
What’s the story or meaning behind the title “Liberator”? How did you decide on it?
I felt that SHY’s desire to bring happiness to others, despite all her struggles, is very similar to PassCode. The message we convey isn’t all that different, which is why this song reflects both SHY’s perspective and PassCode’s essence.
This song depicts the life of the anime’s protagonist, Flum, and the lyrics ask the listener, “To protect the people who matter to you, can you overcome your weaknesses, defy fate, and shape the future?” The title Liberator isn’t just about someone who saves others, it also represents someone who frees them from their constraints and even rewrites destiny.
How did the story or themes of the anime “Roll Over and Die” influence the way you approached “Liberator”?
We thought some people might skip the anime’s opening, so we decided to structure the song to start with the vocals right away.
Since there are so many monsters, I think the song ended up with screams that sound like growls, giving it a serious, intense atmosphere.
And if you could spend one day in the world of Roll Over and Die, which character would you want to be, and why?
Cyrill. I’d want to be Cyrill and clear up Flum’s misunderstandings.
I’d want to be Flum so I could watch the cute Milkit up close and have her all to myself.
I’d want to be Sara. Her heart is pure, she’s innocent, and above all, she’s adorable, so I’d like to be her and help a lot of people.
Flum! Strong, cool girls are the best.
What are your goals for 2026, and do you have any messages for your fans?
I want to do lots of things that will get our fans excited. And someday, I’ll go see everyone again.
Thank you always for your support. 2026 is our 10th anniversary year, so I want to make it an even more exciting year!
In 2026, I want to visit places I’ve never been before, both in Japan and abroad, whether for live shows or privately. Thank you for always supporting us, and please look forward to what’s coming next from PassCode!
Releasing lots of cool songs! We’ll continue evolving and come see everyone again.
We've been really enjoying Roll Over and Die, and PassCode’s opening theme is definitely one of the highlights! After this interview, it’s clear just how much the group continues to grow and evolve, and it’s exciting to see where these talented artists are headed after a decade-long journey. Now, if you’ll excuse us, we’ll be going back to blasting “Liberator” at full volume...
Connect with PassCode Official website: passcode-official.com/ X (formerly Twitter): x.com/passcodeo Instagram: instagram.com/passcodeo YouTube: youtube.com/@PASSCODE0000 TikTok: tiktok.com/@passcode_o Facebook: facebook.com/PassCodeOfficial

Daoko’s Upcoming Single “COMIT COMET” Chosen as Opening Theme for Yowayowa Sensei
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Daoko will digitally release her new song “COMIT COMET” on April 12, 2026. The track has been selected as the opening theme for the TV anime Yowayowa Sensei, which begins airing in April 2026.
  • The original manga is currently serialized in Weekly Shonen Magazine. A hugely popular romantic comedy, it follows Hiyori Hiwamura, a timid and somewhat unreliable new English teacher. Though weak and meek in both appearance and personality, she is mistakenly feared by her students as a scary teacher. Supported by her student Abikura, she gradually grows into her role. Despite being at the mercy of her students, she faces them earnestly, gradually building bonds of trust in a story full of humor.
  • The song is composed and arranged by Hideya Kojima, who has worked on numerous Daoko tracks, including “ShibuyaK” and “Moshimo Bokura ga GAME no Shuyaku de.” Blending strong Shibuya-kei influences from the ’90s and 2000s with elements of contemporary overseas funk, the track is described as Daoko’s grooviest and cutest to date. A preview of “COMIT COMET” can be heard in the newly released main promotional video for Yowayowa Sensei.

    • Daoko’s Comment

    While working on the song, I read the original manga and found myself charmed by the cuteness and earnestness of Yowayowa-sensei (Hiyori Hiwamura). I wanted to express that feeling by likening it to the stars, so I teamed up with Hideya Kojima and poured everything into creating a full-on pop track. The result is a “star-core” anisong we’re really proud of. I’m already looking forward to seeing all the different sides of Yowayowa-sensei brought to life in the anime.

    Release Information

    Daoko Digital Single “COMIT COMET” Digital Release Date: April 12, 2026 Lyrics: Daoko Composition: Hideya Kojima, Daoko Arrangement: Hideya Kojima Pre-add/Pre-save it here: lnk.to/COMIT_COMET Jacket Design: Hazuki Tamano (Yoyo Inc.) Key Illustration: Akatsuki Hono Supervision: Yoshiko Takemoto ©Kamio Fukuchi, KODANSHA/“Yowayowa Sensei”Production Committee
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Daoko's Profile

    Tokyo-born in 1997, Daoko rose to prominence at 15 with a song uploaded to Niconico Douga, making her major debut in 2015. Since then, she’s been active across music, anime, and commercial projects. Her hit collaboration with Kenshi Yonezu, “Uchiage Hanabi,” has surpassed 600 million views on YouTube. A multi-talented creator, Daoko has also written novels, organized live events, held painting exhibitions, and acted, earning high acclaim both in Japan and abroad. She founded her own agency, teftef, in 2019. Alongside her solo activities, she began performing as part of the band QUBIT in 2023. In 2024, she released her first solo album in about four years, Slash-&-Burn, and drew attention with her featured appearance on Shiina Ringo’s seventh album track, “a grand triumphant return.” In 2025, she attracted further notice for her collaboration with Giga & TeddyLoid, “ACT feat. Daoko.” On November 19, her latest EP meta millefeuille was released digitally. item.title: Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! Special-edition Blu-ray to be released August 26, 2026!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! is the first-ever collaborative performance between Pokémon and Hatsune Miku. A special-edition Blu-ray featuring all the songs from the live evening performance of March 22 will be released August 26, 2026.
  • Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! was held from Friday, March 20, 2026 to Sunday March 22, 2026 at the Lala Arena Tokyo Bay, starring Hatsune Miku and the other virtual singers, along with a host of Pokémon running about on stage, performing the entire catalogue of PokéMiku songs.
  • The Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! special-edition Blu-ray will include live recordings of the entire setlist performed on the evening of Sunday, March 22. Bonus contents include a booklet featuring photos from the performance and illustrations, an acrylic stand of Hatsune Miku and Meloetta, and a set of postcards. The special case features the main visual, illustrated by Take.

    • Product Information

    Title: Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! Blu-ray Special-edition Date: Wednesday, August 26, 2026 Price: 15,400 yen (14,000 yen tax ex.) / VTZL-268

    Description

    “I want to sing all the PokéMiku songs with you!” PokéMiku hits the stage! Starring Hatsune Miku and the other virtual singers, along with a host of Pokémon running about on stage, performing the entire catalogue of PokéMiku songs! Pokémon feat. Hatsune Miku VOLTAGE Live! is the first-ever collaborative performance between Pokémon and Hatsune Miku, held Friday, March 20, 2026 to Sunday March 22, 2026 at the Lala Arena Tokyo Bay. A special-edition Blu-ray featuring the entire setlist from the evening performance of March 22 will be released August 26, 2026! Bonus contents include a booklet featuring photos from the performance and illustrations, an acrylic stand of Hatsune Miku and Meloetta, and a set of postcards, all in one gorgeous package! Official Blu-ray Website: project-voltage.jp/blu-ray Official Event Website: project-voltage.jp/live2026

    Special-edition contents

    Live photo and illustration booklet Stage Visual Acrylic Stand (Hatsune Miku & Meloetta) Set of postcards Special case

    About "PokéMiku"

    In 1996, the video game Pokémon was released. In 2007, the vocal synthesis software featuring Hatsune Miku was released. PokéMiku is a collaborative project between two franchises that have enriched both the real and virtual worlds. Since its launch on August 31, 2023, we’ve been collaborating with a diverse group of creators who continue to explore new forms of expression by sampling music from the Pokémon series to create songs and music videos performed by Hatsune Miku and her friends, as well as creating illustrations such as the “18 Variations of Hatsune Miku & her Pokémon.”

    About Pokémon

    Pokémon, short for Pocket Monsters, are mysterious creatures shrouded in secrets. The franchise began in 1996 with two games for GameBoy, Pokémon Red and Pokémon Green. The games are packed with elements such as the “collectible” aspect of catching and raising pokémon, and the “social” aspect of trading and battling with friends. The franchise has since become a worldwide phenomenon, expanding to include card games, TV anime and movies, apps, and merchandise.

    About Hatsune Miku

    A software that allows anyone to create songs by entering lyrics and melodies, developed by Crypton Future Media, Inc. It quickly became a major movement as numerous creators began making music with “Hatsune Miku” and uploading the songs online. Since gaining attention as a character, “Hatsune Miku” now performs as a virtual singer with live performances and merchandise, with their popularity spreading worldwide. *Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO are also virtual singers developed by Crypton Future Media, Inc.

item.title: Mirror Shibuya, an Illustrated Audio Drama Starring SZNO, the Multidimensional Artist from Bandai Namco Music Live × MusicRay’n, Begins Streaming March 21, 2026
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. (Head office: Shibuya-ku, Tokyo; President: Yoshitaka Tao) has announced that Mirror Shibuya, an illustrated audio drama starring SZNO (pronounced “Suzuno”), will begin streaming on SZNO’s YouTube channel on March 21, 2026.
  • SZNO is a multidimensional artist project operating in both the real and virtual realms, jointly developed by Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. and MusicRay’n. Mirror Shibuya will be a six-episode story depicting a series of strange occurrences in Shibuya. Viewers can further immerse themselves in SZNO’s world through the songs and videos released on her YouTube channel.
  • The world and character concepts for SZNO were developed by a stellar lineup of creators, including Jin, the creator of Kagerou Project; Ritao (PHASE STUDIO), who contributed to KAF and Project SEKAI: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku; and Seiji Mizushima, known for directing Mobile Suit Gundam 00.
  • In the second teaser video, it was announced that voice actress Eriko Nakamura, known for her role as Haruka Amami in THE IDOLM@STER, will play the mysterious bat in Mirror Shibuya. Seven VTubers from the MEWLIVE production, operated by Bandai Namco Music Live, will also appear: Kotori Koiwai as BearTrice Kumano, Nozomi Suzuhara as Kurone Yousagi, Yuno Mihanada, Ririka Tsukimia, Miu Koneko, Roiro Yamiyori, and Nemumi Nukunuku.
  • The project is planned as a new urban fantasy work combining music, subculture, and urban legends, centered on both real Shibuya and another Shibuya. Further updates will be announced on SZNO’s official social media and website.
    • https://youtu.be/atM-DEpv-g4 “Hoshii” (SZNO’s 5th single), which is played in the 2nd teaser video, is now available on music streaming websites! Links: lnk.to/LZC-3301 Official Audio: youtube.com/watch?v=PFOtoKK3PBQ　 https://youtu.be/PFOtoKK3PBQ Lyrics, Composition: Ren Nakai Arrangement: Yamato

    Staff

    Setting/Character Design Concept Collaboration: Jin Character Design: Ritao (PHASE STUDIO) Scenario: Hisakatsu Kuroki Music Director: Seiji Mizushima Production: Hifumi, Inc. Planning and Production: SZNO Project (Bandai Namco Music Live, MusicRay’n)

    Cast

    SZNO: SZNO Yuno: Yuno Mihanada Ririka: Ririka Tsukimia Miu: Miu Koneko Roiro: Roiro Yamiyori Nemumi: Nemumi Nukunuku Kumano: BearTrice Kumano Kurone: Kurone Yousagi Bat: Eriko Nakamura

    Story

    Two Shibuyas: one of shadow, one of light. In the shadow, a sinister presence stirs, spreading fear and negative emotions among the people. In the midst of all this, Yuno, a member of the idol group Spark★Twinkle, is attacked and falls unconscious. When she awakens, she finds herself in a strange, mirrored world where everything is flipped. At her lowest point, a mysterious girl named SZNO appears. What is the hidden truth of Shadow Shibuya? And what is SZNO’s true identity and purpose? A story of intertwining mysteries is about to unfold in the darkness.

    About SZNO

    SZNO is a multidimensional artist project that operates in both the real and virtual realms. It was born from a collaboration between Bandai Namco Music Live, known for its Lantis label and expertise in producing music content like the Love Live! series, and MusicRay’n, a Sony Music Group company renowned for discovering and nurturing talent such as Sphere, TrySail, and CHiCO. A stellar lineup of creators has come together for this project, including Jin, the creator of the Kagerou Project, and Ritao (PHASE STUDIO), who has been involved in creative work for KAF and Project SEKAI: Colorful Stage! feat. Hatsune Miku. As new songs and story videos are released, the world of SZNO is gradually revealed. Showcasing a range of styles with their debut single “xx,” second single “flag,” and third single “21g,” SZNO has captured attention, with the music videos for “xx” and “flag” each surpassing one million views. Their fourth single, “Mata ne,” is a ballad that wraps listeners in a bittersweet yet warm mood, carried by tender, compassionate, and crystal-clear vocals. The accompanying official music video features SZNO appearing outdoors for the first time, contemporary dance elements, and connections to their first single, “xx,” making it a must-see.

    A VTuber production operated by Bandai Namco Music Live, Mewlive brings together a diverse roster of talent, from experienced voice actresses and artists to those who began their careers from scratch through auditions. The group values close engagement with fans through game streams, casual chats, music activities, live performances, and both online and real-world events. item.title: ZAQ to Digitally Release “Liar Veil,” Ending Theme for Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester, on April 2
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • ZAQ’s new song “Liar Veil” has been chosen as the ending theme for the anime Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester, which will begin airing in April 2026. This marks ZAQ’s fourth collaboration with the Classroom of the Elite series, and the first time she has performed an ending theme for the franchise.
  • Built on a hip-hop and jazz foundation, “Liar Veil” combines a simple structure with intricate melodic lines. The lyrics are written from the heroine’s perspective, further enriching the world of the series. The song will be released digitally on April 2, ahead of the CD release on April 22.
  • The tracklist and jacket art have also been revealed. Inspired by the title “Liar Veil,” the front cover evokes an eerie yet alluring atmosphere, hinting at truths hidden behind a veil. The back cover features Tsubasa Nanase and Ichika Amasawa, with protagonist Kiyotaka Ayanokoji appearing in the background. What truths lie hidden beneath these veils? The artwork invites fans to reflect on this question while exploring the song’s lyrics.

    • Product Information

    Title: Liar Veil Release Date: April 22, 2026 Title Track Early Digital Release: April 2, 2026 Product No.: LACM-24820 Price: ¥1,320 (tax included) Tracklist 1. Liar Veil Lyrics/Composition/Arrangement: ZAQ 2. Danmari Lyrics/Composition/Arrangement: ZAQ 3. Liar Veil (Off Vocal) 4. Danmari (Off Vocal)

    ZAQ's Profile

    ZAQ began playing piano at age three and graduated from a university music program with a degree in piano. While studying classical music, she also immersed herself in rock, R&B, hip-hop, and other pop genres, and was struck by the musical sophistication of anime songs. In 2012, she debuted as a creator by writing, composing, and arranging a character song for the TV anime Future Diary. In October of the same year, she made her major debut with “Sparkling Daydream,” the opening theme for Love, Chunibyo & Other Delusions!. She has since performed opening themes for series including Trinity Seven, Concrete Revolutio, and Classroom of the Elite. She also wrote, composed, and co-arranged the theme song for Animelo Summer Live 2017 -THE CARD-, one of Japan’s largest anime music events, further establishing herself as both an artist and a creator. In recent years, she has provided songs to numerous artists across label lines. As an arranger, sound producer, and singer-songwriter, ZAQ aims to forge a new “classic” style of anime music in a scene that often trends toward uniformity. PassCode Releases Documentary of Arena Show “PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 ‘DESTINEX’” to Celebrate New Track “Liberator”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • On March 4, 2026, the female vocal and dance group PassCode released their new single “Liberator.” The Blu-ray included with the Limited First Edition features the track’s first live performance during PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX,” held on November 9, 2025.
  • To mark the release, PassCode has unveiled a 35-minute documentary on YouTube, going behind the scenes of PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX.” The film follows the members for several days as they prepare for the arena show, offering rare footage that captures their determination and tension leading up to the big day.
  • “Liberator” is currently being used as the opening theme of the TV anime Roll Over and Die. The song pairs lyrics that reflect the feelings of the protagonist, Flum, with chilling shouted vocals that evoke its dark world, while a grand choir chorus adds further depth.
  • The music video, directed by Takuya Oyama of VANLI, is also now available. It features a dark fantasy aesthetic, with meticulously designed spaces created through a combination of CG and VFX.
  • In conjunction with the single’s release, PassCode will hold a short tour of Tokyo, Nagoya, and Osaka, titled the “Liberator Release Tour 2026.” They are also set to appear at DEAD POP FESTiVAL 2026 on April 4 at a special outdoor venue in Higashi‑Ogishima East Park in Kawasaki. With the group celebrating the 10th anniversary of their debut this October, fans can look forward to more exciting news.
    • https://youtu.be/giLiHAcLqrE

    Product Information

    New Single “Liberator” Release Date: March 4, 2026 Artist: PassCode Limited First Edition (CD+Blu-ray): ¥8,250 (tax included) / LAMR-34040 Standard Edition (CD only) ¥1,540 (tax included) / LAMR-4040 CD (Limited First Edition & Standard Edition) 1. Liberator (OP of TV anime Roll Over and Die) 2. AWANE 3. Every time, I knew 4. Liberator -Instrumental- 5. AWANE -Instrumental- 6. Every time, I knew -Instrumental- Blu-ray (Limited First Edition only) PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX” DESTINEX | ONE STEP BEYOND | Ray | VIRIVIRI | SKILLAWAKE | Club Kids Never Die | FLAVOR OF BLUE | Future's near by | Voice | Liberator | MIRAGE WALKER | GROUNDSWELL | Freely | Anything New | Asterisk | MISS UNLIMITED | Tonight | rise in revolt | WILLSHINE | It's you | Echoes | Clouds Across The Moon *Limited First Edition includes audio commentary. *Both editions include one of eight random trading cards https://youtu.be/TgSG9VxKI-I “Liberator” on music streaming and download websites: lnk.to/AMR-4040d PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX” streaming websites: lnk.to/LZC-3360

    About PassCode

    PassCode consists of four members: Nao Minami, Kaede Takashima, Hinako Ogami, and Emily Arima. They have a versatile repertoire based on a band sound, punctuated by their distinctive shouts and screams, and have performed at numerous major festivals such as SUMMER SONIC and ROCK IN JAPAN FESTIVAL, earning broad support from both rock enthusiasts and idol fans. After making their major debut in 2016, they released their first international album Ex Libris PassCode in America, Europe, and Canada under the UK’s JPU Records in October 2018. The track “Ichikabachika” from their 2019 album CLARITY was selected as the opening theme for the TV drama Kakegurui season 2 and the movie Kakegurui. In 2020, their single “STARRY SKY,” which was chosen as the theme song for the drama 182 Days Left, earned them their first-ever No. 1 on the Oricon Weekly Single Chart and Billboard JAPAN Weekly Single Chart. They also made their debut appearance on Nippon Broadcasting System’s All Night Nippon 0. In February 2022, they held their first concert at Nippon Budokan. In 2023, they embarked on their first US tour, “PassCode US / JAPAN TOUR 2023 -GROUNDSWELL-,” which included stops in Dallas, Los Angeles, and New York, as well as 11 cities and 12 venues in Japan. In June 2024, they moved to Bandai Namco Music Live. Their September release “WILLSHINE” was chosen as the OP theme for season 2 of the anime SHY, and their new song “SKILLAWAKE” was selected as the OP theme for season 2 of As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World. In June 2025, PassCode released their fourth major album INSIGNIA, and in November, they held their first arena show in about three years and nine months, PassCode YOKOHAMA BUNTAI 2025 “DESTINEX.” Official website: passcode-official.com Official fan club “Linkage” website: fannect.jp/passcode-linkage Social Media: X: twitter.com/passcodeo YouTube: youtube.com/user/PASSCODE0000 Facebook: facebook.com/PassCodeOfficial Instagram: instagram.com/passcodeo

TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo theme songs announced!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo was first serialized in Shogakukan’s monthly shonen manga magazine, Gessan. The highly-rated series that has won the U-NEXT award for the 2022 Next Manga Awards, ranked first by multiple bookstores for manga recommended by staff in 2023, and been received enthusiastically by professional buyers has been adapted into an anime that will begin airing in April 2026. The story is a homely comedy that centers around an encounter between first-year middle school student Arata Kouda and Kujima, a strange creature that crossed over to Japan from Russia, that triggers a gradual change in his household.
  • The opening theme song to this highly anticipated anime will be done by none other than Galileo Galilei! The rock band is well known by anime fans thanks to its ties to various anime and their hit theme songs for series’ such as Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw and season two of Ao no Orchestra. Their newest single “Komorebizaka” was born from a heartfelt request by Akira Konna, the author of Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo, and was written specifically to serve as the opening theme song for the new anime.
  • The band’s signature transparent melodies and lyrics by their frontman Yuuki Ozaki craft a beautiful and emotional song born from mutual respect between artists, acting like a mirror into the heartwarming world of Kujima. This marks their second consecutive collaboration with an anime, following their single “Amadeus” which was released last October.
  • In addition, the ending theme song will be performed by percussionist and composer Manami Kakudo, who will be handling the composition of the anime soundtrack and theme song for the first time. Previously, she’s performed as a percussionist for various artists such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. She’s been actively releasing music, including her major debut album oar in 2020 and her second album Contact in 2024. Her cover of Maki Asakawa’s “Watashi no Kinyoubi”, featured on oar, gained significant attention on Spotify. In 2026, she began expanding her activities into live performances and music video production. She’s referred to as a “genius” among her peers for her rare sensibilities and one-of-a-kind methods.
  • The lyrics, composition, arrangement and vocals for the ending theme song “Hororo Shoyo” (“shoyo” means to stroll or take a walk) was created entirely by Manami Kakudo herself. The edgy song was created with the friendship between Kujima and Arata in mind. It’s a heartwarming track with a simple, child-like melody that gradually infuses modern and Latin American musical elements. Repeated listens offer a strange experience that allows the track to seep into your ears and savor her extraordinary talent.
  • The opening theme song and ending theme song will begin pre-streaming Friday, April 10 at midnight (JST).
  • The artists have shared their comments! Along with this press release, the author Akira Konno also gave a special comment regarding the new theme songs.

    • Comment from Yuuki Ozaki from Galileo Galilei (“Komorebizaka” OP theme)

    When I read the original work ahead of producing the track, it brought back feelings from when I was in my teens. Like when I would watch the birds flying in the sky while thinking about things at that age. This work captured the feeling of being small and having a separate inner world that overlaps with the landscape in a way that feels like “art.” Rather than put it into words, I created a track by embracing Kujima and the story’s atmosphere as my own melancholy, while always keeping characters in mind. I think that’s why the track goes so well with the story. I was incredibly happy to hear that the author Konno-sensei listened to my music before. This is a special collaboration in which you can feel the connection between our music and the author’s work. Find “Komorebizaka” (OP theme song): lnk.to/GG_Komorebizaka

    Comment from Yuuki Ozaki from Galileo Galilei (“Komorebizaka” OP theme)

    Hello, I’m Manami Kakudo and I’m performing the ending theme song for TV anime Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo. My hope is that different landscapes unfold at the entrance and exit through the story and the music. I made this song hoping that it will become that device. Find “Hororo Shoyo” (ED theme song): lnk.to/KakudoManami_Hororo_Shoyo

    Comment from Akira Konno (author of Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo)

    About “Komorebizaka”: Before discussions about an anime adaptation began, I often thought about how Galileo Galilei would make a great fit for this series while I was drawing Kujima. “Komorebizaka” is a song that’s chill but warm, and allows you to feel the vastness of the sky while sitting on the ground. I’m grateful that this song expands the world of Kujima even more! About “Hororo Shoyou”: It feels like watching Arata and Hororo from a distance as they walk. Kakudo-san’s voice is wonderful, soothing, and the instrumentals sound like birds chirping or trees rustling. It’s a song that leaves a gentle afterglow. I want to listen to it while taking a walk.

    Galileo Galilei's Profile

    Yuuki Ozaki (vocals, guitar) and Kazuki Ozaki (drums) formed the rock band in 2007 in Wakkanai, Hokkaido. In 2008, they won the Senko Riot grand prix and made their major debut in 2010 with their first mini album Hamanasu no Hana. Their transparent melodies and delicate lyrics have gathered support from fans around the world. After their debut, they released numerous hits such as “Natsuzora” (OP theme song for Big Windup! 2) and “Aoi Shiori” (OP theme song for Ano Hana: The Flower We Saw). In 2016, after their concert at the Nippon Budokan, they went on hiatus but have since resumed activities since October 2022 with a new lineup featuring Yuuki Ozaki, Kazuki Ozaki, Masaki Okazaki (bass) and original founding member Fumito Iwai (guitar). On October 11, 2025, the guitarist DAIKI, who had been an active member in Bird Bear Hare and Fish (BBHF) alongside Yuuki and Kazuki and had served as a support guitarist for Galileo Galilei, officially joined the band. They released “Amadeus”, the OP theme song for TV anime Ao no Orchestra Season 2, that same month. Official Website: galileogalilei.jp Official YouTube: youtube.com/@GalileoGalileiOfficial X Account: x.com/galileo_news Instagram: instagram.com/galileogalileiphoto TikTok: tiktok.com/@gg_galileo

    Manami Kakudo's Profile

    Born in Nagasaki, Japan. Musician and percussionist. She explores free expression of her music domestically and internationally through use of diverse percussion instruments such as marimba, her own voice, spoken word, music boxes and tape players. In 2020, she made her major debut as a solo artist with her first album oar. In 2024, she released her second album Contact. She’s earned the trust of many unique artists through supporting their activities outside of her solo career, such as cero, Haruomi Hosono, Tomoyo Harada, and Shun Ishiwaka Songbook Project. While she has been involved in various forms of music production for commercials, films, stage plays, dance and art, she made her debut as a composer for the anime series Kujima Utaeba Ie Hororo. Official Website: manamikakudo.com Official YouTube: youtube.com/@manami_kakudo X Account: x.com/cat_typingg Instagram: instagram.com/manamikakudo_

item.title: ASH DA HERO to Release New Single on May 27! “BELIEVERS” Chosen as Opening Theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • ASH DA HERO has announced the release of their new single “BELIEVERS” on May 27, 2026. The title track will serve as the opening theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2, marking the band’s first anime tie-in since 2024.
  • The new song “BELIEVERS” was once again produced by sound producer Ryo “Lefty” Miyata. Built on a fast-paced band sound, the track is a high-energy rock number about pushing forward despite feelings of inferiority and inner conflict, delivered in the direct, passionate style that defines the band.
  • Ahead of the broadcast, the latest PV for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2 was released, offering the first preview of “BELIEVERS.” The song will be released digitally in advance on April 13 to coincide with the start of the TV broadcast. The cover artwork features a newly drawn illustration of Will created specifically for this release.
  • The CD will also include several coupling tracks: a newly reworked version of “Prologue,” the song that marked the beginning of ASH DA HERO, reflecting the band’s journey over the past ten years; and a self-cover of “MANIFESTO,” originally a song by GYROAXIA for which ASH wrote both the lyrics and music.
  • The first press limited edition will include a Blu-ray Disc featuring footage from the world tour final held on November 8, 2025, at KT Zepp Yokohama, which also served as the band’s 10th anniversary concert.

    • Comment from ASH DA HERO's Vocalist, ASH

    I’m ASH from ASH DA HERO, and we’ll be performing the opening theme for Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 2. I’m a big fan of the original manga, so I’m truly happy and honored to have been entrusted with the theme song. Season 2 has some shocking developments in store. “BELIEVERS” is a song I wrote with my love for Wistoria and my support for Will and the others. I hope this song gives you the courage to take that first swing. Thanks for your support!

New Ghost in the Shell Scheduled for July 2026! With Music by Taisei Iwasaki, Ryo Konishi and Yuki Kanesaka!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Ghost in the Shell is a series revered by fans worldwide, and continues to leave an impact on creators across borders and generations. In conjunction with the opening of the first-ever Ghost in the Shell exhibition “Ghost and the Shell”, currently being held at NODE Tokyo, it was announced that the latest TV anime production of Ghost in the Shell will be airing in Japan starting July 2026. The very first key visual and promotional video was released as well.
  • The first key visual and original artwork from the series is currently on display at the “Ghost and the Shell” exhibition.
  • The musical producers for the new series have also been announced! The musical director is Taisei Iwasaki, known for composing the score for Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime (Belle), which won a Japan Academy Award for “Best Music”. In addition, Ryo Konishi, who served as the music director the Osaka World Expo and produces for artists such as Chara+YUKI, Mrs. Green Apple, TOMOO and more, will be collaborating with U.S.-based composer Yuki Kanesaka, who produced the music for TV anime Dr. Stone.
  • Updates will be posted to the new Ghost in the Shell website and official social media accounts.
    • https://youtu.be/xl8bNn3BRRM Ghost in the Shell Exhibition “Ghost and the Shell” tokyonode.jp/sp/exhibition-ghostintheshell

    About Taisei Iwasaki

    Award-winning musician who’s known for his work on Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime, Hateshinaki Scarlet, Giant God Warrior Appears in Tokyo, TV anime Kekkai Sensen, Spriggan, Marriage Toxin, and more. Moteki and Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime won the 35th and 45th Japan Academy Awards for “Best Music” respectively, while Ryuu to Sobakasu Hime went on to win the 36th Japan Golden Disc Award for “Best Soundtrack of the Year”.

    Comment from Taisei Iwasaki

    “In middle school, I came across a magazine with an illustration of Motoko Kusanagi inside. That was the moment when I discovered Ghost in the Shell. Its unique touch and color set it apart from other works. Even the author’s name, Masamune Shirow, captivated me. I was stunned. I’ve since encountered the series in various forms. Now, I am truly honored to be a part of this project and its long history. The concept I envisioned for this project is “Sound Public Security Sector 9”. With the help of my talented friends, I will strive to make this long-awaited work even better. May we all come together soon.

    About Ryo Konishi

    Born July 25, 1988 in Tokyo. Musical composer, arranger, and performer on saxophone, flute, clarinet, synthesizer, and vocoder. He served as the musical director for the opening ceremony of the Osaka World Expo, and has produced for numerous theatre productions, drama productions, and artists including Chara+YUKI, Mrs. Green Apple, TOMOO and more. His style as a performer involves mastering and playing multiple instruments, making him a valuable multi-instrumentalist in multiple settings including Chara and Millenium Parade led by Daiki Tsuneta. He’s participated in numerous festivals both domestically and internationally, including NHK’s “Kohaku Uta Gassen”, Fuji Rock Festival, and Summer Sonic.

    Comment from Ryo Konishi

    “I first watched Innocence when I was in junior high school. Ever since my heart was stolen by its intense charm, I’ve pursued everything related to Ghost in the Shell. Its influence is deeply ingrained into my own work and philosophy. At first, I couldn’t believe that I was entrusted with creating music for this work, but I wanted to embrace this precious world. With that feeling in my heart, I took on this project with my entire body and soul. Follow the whispers of my ghost!”

    About Yuki Kanesaka

    A music creator and composer based in Boston, creating music daily across the U.S. and Europe. In recent years, he’s been working as an assistant professor at Berklee College of Music, discovering music and developing technology, while also developing products for companies like Sony and AlphaThetha/Pioneer. He enjoys working and can play around 74 instruments. Recent works: - Shiryu Sejima (artist) - Dr. Stone/Jujutsu Kaisen/Snowball Earth (anime music) - olkswagen/Kyupi/Meiji/Yonex (commercial music) - Jojo’s Bizarre Adventure/Sonic Racing (game music)

    Comment from Yuki Kanesaka

    “I began with a single utterance: “Ghost in the Shell? Never heard of it!”, before immediately ordering every English and Japanese version I could get on Amazon. As I dove into composing at my private studio in Boston, a vast number of motifs began preparing for their musical journey. To Nashville, where my allies wait, for additional recordings. To a Shanghai hotel, for tailoring. Finally, the motifs’ journey comes to an end in Tokyo, transforming from a phenomenon called “a passage” into a message called “a suite”. A journey without hesitation, without blurring, without rewriting. These songs are like maps, etched with a trail of my thoughts and impulses. AVIOT Opens Pre-Orders for Second Wave of The Prince of Tennis II Collaboration True Wireless Earbuds!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • AVIOT, operated by Preseed Japan Corporation, which manufactures and sells consumer electronics, has opened orders for its second wave of The Prince of Tennis II collaboration true wireless earbuds. The latest additions to the line-up are the TE-V1R-TP3, inspired by Hyōtei Gakuen Junior High School (Hyōtei), and the TE-V1R-TP4, inspired by Shitenhoji Junior High School (Shitenhoji).
  • Based on the TE-V1R, the TE-V1R-TP3 and TE-V1R-TP4 are special edition wireless earbuds designed to fully capture the charm of The Prince of Tennis II.
  • Both models feature eight characters’ voices. The Hyōtei model includes Keigo Atobe, Yushi Oshitari, Ryoh Shishido, Gakuto Mukahi, Jiroh Akutagawa, Munehiro Kabaji, Chotaroh Otori, and Wakashi Hiyoshi, while the Shitenhoji model features Kuranosuke Shiraishi, Senri Chitose, Koharu Konjiki, Yuji Hitouji, Kenya Oshitari, Gin Ishida, Hikaru Zaizen, and Kintaroh Toyama.
  • Together, the two models contain 330 newly recorded voice lines, from operational voice guidance for notifications like power and connection status to a “random voice” function that plays memorable quotes from the series. Users can switch between 16 modes through the dedicated app.
  • From the earbuds and charging case to the packaging, every detail has been carefully crafted for a premium, fan-focused experience, with audio tuned by series composer UZA for optimal music playback. In the promotional video, Kenya Oshitari and Yushi Oshitari themselves introduce the products. Please check it out!
    • https://youtu.be/LKSdf6aG2o8

    Product Characteristics

    Base Model The TE-V1R is the latest model in AVIOT’s popular V series, which has sold approximately 190,000 units*. The earbuds offer an ultra-long battery life of 19 hours (62 hours with the charging case) and Adaptive Hybrid Noise Canceling, which automatically adjusts the noise reduction strength based on the surrounding environment. They also feature the new Hybrid Dual Driver 2.0 for enhanced sound quality, LDAC™ support for high-resolution playback, and wireless charging functionality, making them a high-grade model that perfectly balances sound quality and functionality. *As of the end of April 2025 Special Voice Lines The earbuds feature over 330 newly recorded lines across two models, including voice guidance for notifications such as power and connection status, as well as a “random voice” function with memorable quotes from the series. The Hyōtei and Shitenhoji models each offer eight modes featuring the schools’ regular players, switchable through the app. To see the other voice lines, please check the product page: aviot.jp/product/te-v1r-tp-s2. Special Design The charging cases sport glossy Hyōtei and Shitenhoji-themed color schemes, with original series logos on the sides and metal earbud parts. Complementing the first wave’s Seigaku and Rikkai models, this series offers a cohesive, collector-friendly set.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Packaging The packaging showcases brand-new illustrations of the players enjoying the earbuds, highlighting their expressions and charm.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Tuning Following the first wave of collaboration models, these earbuds also feature sound tuning by UZA, the composer behind The Prince of Tennis II soundtrack. Enjoy a unique audio experience that lets you feel the excitement of The Prince of Tennis Festival wherever you are.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Product Information

    TE-V1R-TP3, TP4 Price: ¥22,880 (incl. tax) Pre-orders currently open Expected Delivery Date: December 17, 2025 or later Available at: AVIOT ONLINE MALL shop.aviot.jp/products/te-v1r-tp-s2 → Basic Specifications ・Driver: Hybrid type with φ10mm dynamic and balanced armature drivers ・Microphone for calls: MEMS microphone ・Battery capacity: Earbud single ear 85mAh / Case 600mAh ・Talk time*: Up to 9 hours ・Playback time*: Up to 19 hours (with charging case: up to 62 hours) ・Earbud charging time: Approximately 1.5 hours ・Charging port: USB Type-C ・Water resistance level**: Equivalent to IPX4 ・Weight: Earbud single ear approximately 6.5g ・Other features: Multipoint support (up to 2 devices), single ear usage, earbuds can be individually turned on or off, fast charging (up to 120 minutes of playback with a 10-minute charge), wireless charging → Accessories ・Silicone earpieces (1 pair each in sizes S/M/L) ・USB Type-C cable ・User manual → Bluetooth Specifications ・Supported codecs: SBC, AAC, LDAC ・Supported profiles: A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, HSP ・Bluetooth version: 5.3 ・Number of Bluetooth multi-pairing registrable devices: 8 *Exact time may vary depending on your usage environment **Earbuds only

    About AVIOT

    AVIOT, born in 2018 as the original brand of Preseed Japan Corporation, aims to deliver products that convey high-quality Japanese craftsmanship in sound, delicate and beautiful design, and easy-to-use electronic products. In 2023, the brand restarted with the addition of “A Visionary Innovation On Technology” to its name, aiming to be an electronic devices brand that goes beyond the framework of audio-visual products. The vision is to bring innovation through the power of technology and deliver “something that changes your lives” to customers. Company Name: Preseed Japan Corporation Representative: CEO Founder Hirokazu Tsuchiyama Address: 4-16-7 Sendagaya, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo 151-0051, DT Building 3F Business Activities: 1) Manufacturing, importing, and selling wireless audio equipment and IoT-related products 2) Importing and selling mobile accessories 3) Managing an e-commerce website AVIOT Official Website: aviot.jp AVIOT Official X (formerly Twitter): twitter.com/AVIOT_JP AVIOT Official Instagram: instagram.com/aviotjapan AVIOT Official TikTok: tiktok.com/discover/AVIOT

item.title: Nao Toyama Announces Upcoming Hiatus. Final Live Performance at the Nippon Budokan to Be Held Next Year!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Voice actress and singer Nao Toyama’s long-held dream “to reunite with everyone at the Nippon Budokan” will be coming true next year. The 10th Anniversary Final Live “Over The Rainbow at Nippon Budokan” will be held on March 11, 2027 and her upcoming hiatus from musical activities was also announced.
  • The announcement was made during a solo concert on February 8 in front of an in-person and livestream audience. She conveyed her message with a letter and requested her fans’ help in making her dream come true. She described her reason for the upcoming hiatus as “a positive decision to deliver a culmination of her decade-long journey and to think about the next phase of her career.” She did not announce when her upcoming hiatus will end. Her final concert will be held next year on her birthday, March 11, and promises to be a special event filled with emotions and shared alongside all those who’ve walked this path together with her, as they step forward into the future. Tickets to the concert will go on sale Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 10 AM, Japan Standard Time.
  • Furthermore, a new album will be coming out as a culmination of her ten year-long musical career leading up to the Budokan concert. More details will be announced at a later date.
  • In addition, a live birthday countdown stream will be hosted on YouTube on Tuesday, March 10 at 11 PM (JST) where she’ll share more information about tickets and exclusive details regarding her final concert.
    • Nao Toyama’s Special 10th Anniversary Website: jvcmusic.co.jp/flyingdog/toyamanao/10th

    Concert Information

    Title: 10th Anniversary Final Live “Over the Rainbow at Nippon Budokan” Performer: Nao Toyama Date/Time: Thursday, March 11, 2027 at 6 PM (Doors open at 5 PM) Place: Nippon Budokan, Tokyo

    Nao Toyama's Profile

    Birthday: March 11 Blood Type: A Hometown: Tokyo Hobbies: Singing, dancing, playing the electric organ Nao Toyama made her voice acting debut in 2010. She attracted a lot of attention for her role as Kanon Nakagawa in the TV anime The World God Only Knows. After that, she went on to play characters in numerous popular works, such as Karen Kujo in Kin-iro Mosaic, Chitoge Kirisaki in Nisekoi, Reina Prowler in MacrossΔ, and Rin Shima in Yuru CampΔ. She also belongs to popular groups Rhodanthe* and Walküre, both of which were born in anime, and has enthralled fans with her clear voice and flawless performances. On February 1, 2017, she made her debut as a singer with “True Destiny/Chain the world,” tie-up songs for the anime Chain Chronicle: Haecceitas no Hikari, and on February 3, 2018, she held her first solo live at the Nippon Budokan. In 2019, she held her first solo tour and performed overseas in Taipei and Shanghai. In 2020, she celebrated her 10th anniversary as a voice actress by releasing her character song best album “Special Thanks” and holding a 10th anniversary concert titled “Special Thanks! Festival” at Tokyo Garden Theater. In 2022, she celebrated the 5th anniversary of her singing debut with five projects. On February 22, 2025, she held her solo live concert “Watashi no Kangaeta Muteki na Setlist!” Social Media Official X (formerly Twitter): @naobou_official Line account search ID: toyamanao Artist homepage: toyamanao.com Official blog: ameblo.jp/naobouofficial Official YouTube channel: youtube.com/c/naobou_channel Instagram: @naobou_official TikTok account: tiktok.com/@official_naotoyama
