item.title: Entries Open July 1 for Round 3 of the Anime Song Choir Project “ChoieL”, Now Featuring 28 Eligible Songs!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. will begin accepting entries for the third round of its anime song choir project ChoieL on July 1, 2025.
  • ChoieL is an ongoing online choir competition that was launched in August 2022, with a second round in March 2024. Round 3 brings back the 22 songs from previous editions and adds new selections from Bandai Namco Music Live’s SUNRISE MUSIC label, for a total of 28 eligible songs. As before, the contest features two categories: Full and Short.
  • Returning to the judging panel are Sohei Miyoshi (Choral Conductor / Secretary General of the Tokyo Choral Association / Planning and Supervision) and composer Tatsuya Tanaka, both of whom have served as judges since the first round.
  • Joining this round as official ambassadors is ARCANA PROJECT, an artist group from Bandai Namco Music Live’s Lantis label. A promotional video featuring the group is now available. ARCANA PROJECT will also serve as guest judges and present a new “ARCANA PROJECT Award.”
  • Entries will be accepted from July 1 to August 31, 2025, with both the Full and Short categories held concurrently. We look forward to your enthusiastic participation!

    • Participating Judges

    Sohei Miyoshi (Choral Conductor / Secretary General of the Tokyo Choral Association / Planning and Supervision)

    It’s been three years since ChoieL began, and thanks to your support, we’re now entering our third round. The six new songs for Round 3 include titles that will resonate with an even wider range of generations than the original 22. With the addition of new arrangers, we believe this round offers more than ever for both anime song fans and choral music lovers alike. We hope ChoieL continues to be a place where you can express your passion to the fullest.

    Tatsuya Tanaka (Composer)

    The ChoieL online choir competition is now entering its third round. The full lineup of 28 songs, including the six new additions, offers an exciting and enjoyable blend of anime songs and choral music in terms of song selection, arrangement, and composition. The past two competitions were full of unforgettable moments, and we’re already looking forward to seeing how participants will express themselves this time. If you have a passion for anime songs and choral music, that’s all you need to get started. We can’t wait to see your entry!

    Official ChoieL Ambassadors & Judges

    ARCANA PROJECT (Lantis/Artist)

    A vocal unit consisting of Usa Sakurano, Hana Hanamiya, Shion Aida, Hikaru Amano, Yuka Shidomi, and Sakura Yoshino, co-produced by DEARSTAGE and Lantis. With a tarot card-themed group motif, they bring a diverse range of songs, including anime theme songs, to life through their distinctive vocals and performances. Comment: We’re ARCANA PROJECT, and we’re honored to take part in the ChoieL anime song choir project as both official ambassadors and judges. As a group brought together by our love of anime and singing, we’re truly excited to be involved in such a wonderful initiative. Through our work as ARCANA PROJECT, we’ve come to feel that what matters most isn’t technical skill, but the joy of singing while making eye contact, the comfort of shared breath, and the freedom to express music from the heart. Discovering your own voice and connecting with others through song are deeply meaningful and precious experiences. We hope this project brings those same experiences to many people. We can’t wait to hear your voices. https://youtu.be/ivBlGhJhfPc

    About ChoieL

    The anime song choir project “ChoieL” was launched on June 1, 2022, with the aim of bringing together the beloved tradition of choir and the world of anime songs. Our goal is to draw out new charms from each, aspiring to a future where anime songs are loved as standard numbers in the choir world. As the first step of this project, we hosted our first online choir competition in August 2022, and 50 groups participated to showcase the fresh appeal of anime songs. Starting from the second online competition, the project has expanded to include sustainable activities that utilize the intellectual property of anime songs to deliver free music events to young people and fans worldwide. ChoieL Official Website: project-choiel.jp ChoieL Official X (formerly Twitter): twitter.com/Project_ChoieL ChoieL Official Instagram: instagram.com/project_choiel

    Overview of Anime Song Choir Project ChoieL Third Online Competition

    Organizers: Bandai Namco Music Live Inc. Supporter: Tokyo Choral Association Period: July 1, 2025 - August 31, 2025 *The Full and Short Divisions will run concurrently. Judges: Sohei Miyoshi (Choral Conductor / Secretary General of the Tokyo Choral Association / Planning and Supervision) Tatsuya Tanaka (Composer) Bandai Namco Music Live Official Ambassador: ARCANA PROJECT (Lantis/Artist) Entry Fee: There is no entry fee. However, sheet music must be purchased for each participant. Eligibility for Participation: *Applies to all divisions ・Please purchase the electronic sheet music of the song you would like to perform from L SCORE, the official music brand of Namco Bandai Music Live. ・The same choir may participate in both the short and full divisions. ・Multiple song entries are acceptable. (However, only one song per submission). ・A conductor is not required. ・Please play the accompaniment as specified in the score, or download the accompaniment soundtrack from the official website. ・In addition to regular choirs, virtual choirs can also be created by combining individual performances or multiple recordings by a single person. *There is no need to apply for the use of music for this competition. Benefits: Each winning group will receive a commemorative trophy and ChoieL original merchandise for all participants. The grand prize winner will also get to experience recording their choir performance in a professional studio and will receive the final audio recording.

    Eligible Songs (Total of 28 Songs)

    "Rhapsody of Blue Sky", TV anime Miss Kobayashi’s Dragon Maid. Mixed choir, composed by Yuka Yamashita. "Kimi no Kokoro wa Kagayaiteru kai?", Love Live! Sunshine!!. Mixed choir, composed by Chieko Matsunami. "Can Do", TV anime Kuroko’s Basketball. Mixed choir, composed by Noritaka Moriyama. "Thank You!", The Idolm@ster Million Live!. Mixed choir, composed by Ayako Meida. "SKILL", 2nd Super Robot Wars Alpha. Mixed choir, composed by Noritaka Moriyama. "Spread the Wings!!", The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors. Mixed choir, composed by Masaya Ishiwaka. "TOKIMEKI Runners", Love Live! School Idol Festival ALL STARS. Mixed choir, composed by Tomoaki Yokoyama. "DRIVE A LIVE", The Idolmaster: SideM. Mixed choir, composed by Naoto Aizawa. "DREAM SOLISTER", TV anime Sound! Euphonium. Mixed choir, composed by Tatsuya Tanaka. "Bokura no LIVE Kimi to no LIFE", Love Live!. Mixed choir, composed by Tatsuya Tanaka. "Motteke! Sailor Fuku", TV anime Lucky Star. Mixed choir, composed by Tatsuya Tanaka. "MONSTER GENERATiON", Idolish7. Mixed choir, composed by Chieko Matsunami. "Yasashisa no Riyuu", TV anime Hyouka. Mixed choir, composed by Toyotaka Tsuchida. "Violet Snow", TV anime Violet Evergarden. Female choir, composed by Naoto Aizawa. "STARDOM!", TV anime Data Carddass Aikatsu Stars!. Female choir, composed by Tatsuya Tanaka. "Hajimari wa Kimi no Sora", Love Live! Superstar!!. Female choir, composed by Kaori Morita. "Hana no Iro", TV anime Hanasaku Iroha. Female choir, composed by Noritaka Moriyama. "Caste Room", TV anime Classroom of the Elite. Male choir, composed by Noritaka Moriyama. "Dramatic", Ultraman Taiga The Movie. Male choir, composed by Noboru Kitagawa. "Namae wo Yobu yo", TV anime Bungo Stray Dogs. Unaccompanied male choir, composed by Noboru Kitagawa. "Hare Hare Yukai", TV anime The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya. Mixed voice acapella, composed by Chizuru Matsunaga. "Broadcast Parade". Mixed voice acapella, composed by Inhyeok Yeo. "Soldiers of Sorrow", Mobile Suit Gundam II: Soldiers of Sorrow. Male choir, composed by Tatsuya Tanaka. "Yusha Oh Tanjou", TV anime The King of Braves GaoGaiGar. Unaccompanied mixed choir, composed by Noboru Kitagawa. "Yakusoku wa Iranai", TV anime The Vision of Escaflowne. Female choir, composed by Kosuke Negishi. "Anna ni Issho Datta no ni", TV anime Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Mixed choir, composed by Shotaro Miyamoto. "Orion o Nazoru", TV anime Tiger & Bunny. Mixed choir, composed by Miho Fujishima. "Shikairo Days", TV anime My Deer Friend Nokotan. Mixed choir, composed by Chieko Matsunami. For other details, such as participation rules and regulations, please refer to the official website (project-choiel.jp). The scores of all 28 eligible songs are now available on L SCORE, the official music brand of Namco Bandai Music Live! L SCORE official website: lscore.jp ★Videos of all 28 eligible songs are now available on YouTube. youtube.com/playlist?list=PLmgGL3shzkGPIOiTzDqo16yOT96SXPv4F

    About ChoieL’s Sustainable Activities

    Starting from the second online competition, the anime song choir project ChoieL will be carried out as part of the sustainable activities of Bandai Namco Music Live. The Bandai Namco Group has defined its Purpose as “Fun for All into the Future.” Under our IP strategy, the group, along with its fans, will promote sustainable activities to address societal issues. In line with our long term plan, which advocates for sustainability under the theme of “connecting smiles to the future,” we have identified five material issues and are actively working to resolve them. In the anime song choir project ChoieL, we aim to utilize our intellectual property of anime songs to deliver free music events to young people and fans worldwide. To continue being a company cherished by communities and fans, and recognized as essential by society, Bandai Namco Music Live will continue to engage in sustainable activities in the future. Bandai Namco Group Sustainability Page: bandainamco.co.jp/en/sustainability/index.html

item.title: Global Search for the Next Isekai Hit Begins July 7: “MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 - THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA” Launches Worldwide!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="Illustration by Seira Minami" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • KADOKAWA CORPORATION will co-host the novel contest, "MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 - THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA," in partnership with qdopp Inc. and MyAnimeList Co., Ltd. The contest will be held on Honeyfeed, a novel submission platform operated by qdopp, with the goal of discovering exceptional storytelling talent from around the world.
  • This contest aims to discover fresh talent who can craft stories with the potential to stand alongside industry-defining titles like Overlord, Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-, The Rising of the Shield Hero, Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation and Sword Art Online. As an added bonus, the contest features a special guest in the jury panel: Aneko Yusagi, writer of The Rising of the Shield Hero. Winners even receive personalized feedback from this renowned and experienced Isekai author, an incredible chance to gain insight directly from one of the most successful storytellers in the genre.

    • Comment From Satoshi Arima, Project Manager and Editor in Chief of MF BOOKS

    In recent years, Japanese anime has seen a surge in global popularity. Many of these popular anime titles originate from light novels. At KADOKAWA, we are constantly seeking new talent to create the next big hit. Amid this trend, an increasing number of stories styled after Japanese light novels are being posted on overseas novel submission platforms. These platforms are emerging as hubs for content and creators with the potential to achieve widespread success not only in Japan but around the world. In response to this global trend, KADOKAWA has launched the Global UGC Publishing Project as part of its Global Business Acceleration Program, which supports new business ventures targeting international markets. This project aims to discover global talent through overseas novel platforms and bring “internationally-born” light novels to audiences both in Japan and worldwide. The MyAnimeList x Honeyfeed Writing Contest 2025 – THE ISEKAI presented by KADOKAWA marks the first step in this initiative. Moving forward, the project will expand through initiatives such as a Traditional Chinese writing contest hosted on KadoKado - the novel serialization platform operated by KADOKAWA TAIWAN CORPORATION - as well as the publication of selected winning titles from the JNC Original Light Novel Contest organized by M12 Media LLC.

    Contest Information

    Entry fee: Free Writing platform: Honeyfeed Voting platform: MyAnimeList Novel entry period: July 7 to September 29, 2025 Judges voting period: September 30 to November 16, 2025 Public voting period (Finals): November 17 to December 15, 2025 Winners announced: February 9, 2026

    Prizes

    Grand Prize — $5,000 USD Winners: 1 Your novel will be scheduled for publication by KADOKAWA in Japan as a light novel, subject to KADOKAWA’s final approval. Important: The Grand Prize may not be awarded if no submission meets the standards for publication. Contest Winners Prize — $3,000 USD Winners: 2 winners; or 3 if no Grand Prize is selected You might be offered publication of your novel in Japanese by KADOKAWA in Japan as a light novel. For complete contest details, submission guidelines, and updates, visit mhwc.myanimelist.net/202507.

    About KADOKAWA CORPORATION

    KADOKAWA Group, a comprehensive entertainment company, develops a wide range of businesses such as Publication, Animation, Film, Gaming, Web services, and Education/EdTech. We discover talent globally, create diverse IP (Intellectual property), and deliver it through various media. We maximize the value of IP under our strategy “Global Media Mix with Technology” which refers to global rollouts of created IP by utilizing technology. Please visit group.kadokawa.co.jp/global,

    About Honeyfeed

    Honeyfeed is a leading writing platform that empowers authors to create, share, and engage with their original stories. With a vibrant community of readers and writers, Honeyfeed provides an immersive space for storytelling across various genres, including anime and manga-inspired narratives. For more about Honeyfeed, please visit honeyfeed.fm.

    About MyAnimeList (MAL)

    MyAnimeList is one of the world’s largest communities and databases for Japanese anime and manga, with 16 million registered members from 240 countries and regions worldwide. An indispensable site for tracking anime and manga progress, it holds over 1.2 billion records of viewing and reading big data. Founded in 2004, MyAnimeList has become a crucial source of information for overseas fans, especially among Generation Z in North America. For more about MyAnimeList, please visit myanimelist.net.

item.title: ARCANA PROJECT Releases Digital Single “Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka? / Ruby Ruby”
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • ARCANA PROJECT, known for performing theme songs for popular titles such as The Aquatope on White Sand and Ultraman Arc, released their new digital single “Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka? / Ruby Ruby” on June 23.
  • These two tracks serve as the second set of image songs for LINK TRAVELERS, Bandai’s new IP that launched through “shokugan” (candy) and “gashapon” (capsule toys) in May 2025.
  • “Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka?” is a classic idol anthem in the current trend, perfect for energizing a live crowd. In contrast, “Ruby Ruby” offers a nostalgic idol vibe with a fresh, uplifting melody. Both songs have been released in two editions: a Short Size used within the LINK TRAVELERS project, and a Full Size performed by all six members.
    • https://youtu.be/NhFv_0DWhKY

    Product Information

    Digital Single “Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka? / Ruby Ruby” On music services: lnk.to/LZC-3148 Tracklist 1. Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka (Short Size) Artist: ARCANA PROJECT (Usa Sakurano, Hana Hanamiya, Shion Aida, Hikaru Amano) Lyrics, Composition, Arrangement: Shinji Suzuki (KEYTONE) 2. Ruby Ruby (Short Size) Artist: ARCANA PROJECT (Shion Aida, Hikaru Amano) Lyrics: Futa Shintani; Composition, Arrangement: Takaaki Kimura (KEYTONE) 3. Kimi no Ichioshi Arimasu ka Artist: ARCANA PROJECT 4. Ruby Ruby Artist: ARCANA PROJECT

    LINK TRAVELERS Product Overview

    Bandai’s new IP LINK TRAVELERS is built around two main distribution channels: “SIDE:C (CANDY = Shokugan)” and “SIDE:G (GASHAPON = Capsule Toys).” Following the major success of the original capsule toy figure series “Gashapon Quest,” LINK TRAVELERS was announced in November 2024 as its spiritual successor. This new series shifts the stage to both shokugan and gashapon markets for a fresh rollout. Anticipation was high from the start of online pre-orders, and the product officially launched in May 2025. Featuring highly detailed figures and a wide variety of interchangeable parts, the line gives users the freedom to play and customize according to their preferences. Its richly developed story and setting further deepen the imaginative experience. Official Homepage: bandai.co.jp/candy/linktravelers Official Otona no Shokugan X: x.com/otona_shokugan

    ARCANA PROJECT Profile

    ARCANA PROJECT is an anime song vocal unit jointly produced by DEARSTAGE and Lantis. Known for their rich, fantastical sound and the unique tarot card motifs assigned to each member, they have gained strong support, leading to anime tie-ins and performances at major festivals. On April 29, 2025, during the encore of the Tokyo show of their ARCANA PROJECT TOUR 2025 “ARCANA CARAVAN” held at Daikanyama UNIT, the group surprised fans by announcing the addition of two new members: Yuka Shidomi and Sakura Yoshino. Official website: arcana-project.com Official X (formerly Twitter): x.com/arcanaproject Official YouTube: youtube.com/channel/UCVUADERJRI1bG9ez7CyfDnA

item.title: Takuma Terashima to Release 12th Single “more than W”!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Voice actor and artist Takuma Terashima will release his 12th single “more than W” on August 27, 2025. The title track will serve as the ending theme for the TV anime Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin, which begins airing in July. The jacket art and a new artist photo have been revealed.
  • This single features a special collaboration with TAKE from FLOW, who has frequently performed alongside Terashima at events. TAKE handled the music and composition, while Terashima contributed the lyrics himself. The result is a dark, passionate rock track inspired by the elf sisters from the anime.
  • The limited edition comes in a deluxe EP-sized paper jacket. The letter “W” (symbolizing world, word, and twins) is a key motif, and the cover features a slightly eerie, almost optical illusion-like design. The regular edition’s jacket uses an original illustration from the anime, depicting the elf sisters who inspired the track, along with Isla, who watches over them.

    • Product Information

    Limited Edition Product No.: LACM-34742 Price: ¥2,750 (incl. tax) EP-sized paper jacket Regular Edition Product No.: LACM-24742 Price: ¥1,650 (incl. tax) Original Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin illustration Tracklist 1. more than W (Ending Theme of Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin) Lyrics: Takuma Terashima; Composition & Arrangement: TAKE (FLOW)) Plus one coupling song and instrumental versions for a total of four tracks.

    About Takuma Terashima

    Born December 20 in Ishikawa Prefecture, Takuma Terashima belongs to Axlone. He made a spectacular debut as Apollo in the TV anime Genesis of Aquarion, and has since voiced numerous lead roles, including Otoya Ittoki in Uta no Prince-sama: Maji Love 1000% and Shiki Granbell in EDENS ZERO. Known for his impressive vocal abilities in character songs and his top-tier live performances, he is highly regarded within the industry. In June 2022, he celebrated the 10th anniversary of his career as an artist.

    Notable Roles

    Shiki Granbell in EDENS ZERO Shiroe in Log Horizon Lay Grandsley in The Misfit of Demon King Academy Anubis in Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Catt in Sugar Apple Fairy Tale Otoya Ittoki in Uta no Prince-sama: Maji Love 1000% Toma Amagase in The Idolmaster SideM Mahiru Shirota in SERVAMP Hiroshi Ochanomizu in Atom: The Beginning Yaha-kui zaShunina in Kado: The Right Answer Official Homepage: takuma-terashima.lantis.jp Takuma Terashima X: x.com/Terashima_dayo　 Artist Official (Staff) X: x.com/AssembleTour　 Takuma Terashima Official YouTube: youtube.com/@terashima_takuma

[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • SERRA, known for her emotionally resonant voice that has earned her the title “Diva of Emotions,” will release her highly anticipated first album Dawn Light on August 27, 2025, under Bandai Namco Music Live’s label Lantis.
  • SERRA made her major debut with the digital-only single “EYERIS” on November 25, 2022. In April 2023, she performed her first anime tie-in with “Always and Forever,” the ending theme for the TV anime Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke’s Mansion. She wrote both the lyrics and music herself, earning high praise from fellow creators not only for her vocals but also for her songwriting talent.
  • On social media, she launched a viral campaign featuring a cappella videos filmed while holding a lantern. These videos quickly gained widespread attention, sparking a buzz among fans. In 2024, she expanded her activities by providing vocals and original songs for other artists as well.
  • Her long-awaited debut album Dawn Light features ten tracks, including two new songs, a remixed version of her major debut track “EYERIS,” the anime tie-in “Always and Forever,” and the fan-favorite “Blackout.” The album also offers fresh remixes and rearrangements of previous songs, offering listeners a fresh perspective on her work.
  • Reflecting the journey of the “Diva of Emotions,” who faced pain and doubt while holding onto hope, this album captures the fleeting moment of a new dawn, when faint light breaks through deep darkness.

    • SERRA's Comment

    Pain, loneliness, feelings of inferiority, and inner conflict—things I’ve carried alone in the middle of the night. Even in that darkness, I still wanted to believe in the light. My desire to live and keep singing is the light I’ve poured into my first album, Dawn Light. I hope this album offers comfort to your pain and gently illuminates the deepest parts of your heart. Above all, I wish for your night to come to an end and a new dawn to rise. Pre-add/Pre-save Dawn Light on music services lnk.to/LACA-25176d

    Product Information

Tracklist 1. EYERIS (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: Ayato Shinozaki) 2. Tenohira (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: GAKU) 3. Blackout (Lyrics & Music: Yurry Canon / Arrangement: Yuya Hirosawa (HANO), Shinji Hijiki (HANO)) 4. MYTH LOGY (Lyrics: SERRA / Music & Arrangement: Baku Maruyama (a crowd of rebellion)) 5. False Salvation (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: MöC) 6. L machina’s Heartbeat (Lyrics: SERRA / Music: SERRA, MöC / Arrangement: Masatomi Waki (Arte Refact)) 7. Always and Forever (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: Taishi Kawai (Arte Refact)) 8. Genjitsu Touhi Mode (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: hidë) 9. ViVALE (Band Arrange Ver.) (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: hidë) 10. Mira (Lyrics & Music: SERRA / Arrangement: Junki Sakurai)

    About SERRA

    SERRA made her major debut with the digital-only single “EYERIS” on November 25, 2022. In April 2023, she performed her first anime tie-in with “Always and Forever,” the ending theme for the TV anime Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke’s Mansion. She wrote both the lyrics and music herself, earning high praise from fellow creators not only for her vocals but also for her songwriting talent. In 2024, she expanded her activities by providing vocals and original songs for other artists as well. On social media, she launched a campaign sharing a cappella videos, and her voice has since resonated beyond Japan, reaching audiences across Asia. item.title: MindaRyn to Hold First World Tour “Hello New Friends”!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • MindaRyn, the Thai-born anisong singer known for theme songs from hit anime and tokusatsu titles like That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest, and the upcoming Ultraman Omega, will embark on her first world tour, “Hello New Friends,” starting from June 2025.
  • In August 2024, she released her second album Across Miles, featuring many of the anime theme songs she has performed. After appearing at the world’s largest anisong event, Animelo Summer Live 2024 -Stargazer- at Saitama Super Arena, she further expanded her global presence with a performance at ANISAMA WORLD 2025 in Manila.
  • “Hello New Friends” will kick off with a performance at Anime Friends 2025 in Brazil this July, followed by stops in cities across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. At Anime Friends 2025, MindaRyn will also take the stage with ASH, vocalist of ASH DA HERO, in a special collaboration performance of “Missing Link,” the ending theme for Ultraman Omega, airing in July. This exclusive performance, available only on the world tour, is not to be missed.
  • Full tour details will be updated on MindaRyn’s official website.

    • MindaRyn World Tour “Hello New Friends” Schedule

    Anime Friends 2025 Dates: July 3 – July 6, 2025 Location: São Paulo, Brazil Venue: Distrito Anhembi Website: animefriends.com.br Scheduled performance date: Sunday, July 6 NärCon Sommar 2025 Dates: July 24 – July 27, 2025 Location: Linköping, Sweden Venue: Linköping University Website: narcon.se Performance date to be announced. Otakuthon 2025 Dates: August 8 – August 10, 2025 Location: Montreal, Canada Venue: Palais des congrès de Montréal Website: otakuthon.com/2025/home/#gsc.tab=0 Scheduled performance date: Friday, August 8 Otakon 2025 Dates: August 8 – August 10, 2025 Location: Washington, D.C., USA Venue: Walter E. Washington Convention Center Website: otakon.com/?ref=cantonfair.net Scheduled performance date: Sunday, August 10 Costime 6 Dates: October 25 – October 26, 2025 Location: Johor Bahru, Malaysia Venue: Mid Valley Exhibition Centre Johor Bahru Scheduled performance date: Saturday, October 25 ANIEX 2025 Dates: November 22 – November 23, 2025 Location: Bangkok, Thailand Venue: MCC Hall, 3rd Floor, The Mall Life Store Bangkapi Website: facebook.com/aniex.event Scheduled performance date: Saturday, November 22 Please check the official websites of each event for ticketing and additional details. Additional appearances currently being arranged. Further information on performance dates will be announced on MindaRyn’s official website and X (formerly Twitter).

    About MindaRyn

    Originally from Thailand, MindaRyn was exposed to Japanese culture and anime from a young age and eventually relocated to Japan to pursue a career as an anime song singer. She is a trilingual artist fluent in Thai, Japanese, and English. In November 2020, she made her artist debut under Lantis with the ending theme “BLUE ROSE knows” for the TV anime By the Grace of the Gods. Since then, she has performed theme songs for numerous anime and tokusatsu series, including Ultraman Blazar, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, and Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest. In 2024, she appeared at Animelo Summer Live 2024 -Stargazer- at Saitama Super Arena, the world’s largest anisong event. In 2025, she will perform “Missing Link,” the first ending theme for the tokusatsu drama Ultraman Omega airing from July, featuring ASH, the vocalist of ASH DA HERO. item.title: Mekakushe’s “Yuwanamerou” (from Kowloon Generic Romance) Now Streaming!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Singer/songwriter mekakushe’s song “Yuwanamerou,” which was used in Episode 10 of the TV anime series Kowloon Generic Romance, was released online on June 8.
  • Kowloon Generic Romance is a hugely popular mystery-romance anime based on Jun Mayuzuki (of After the Rain fame)’s latest work, which has sold more than 1.5 million copies.
  • Following the ending theme “Retronym of Love” and the Episode 7 insert song “Watashi Dake no Polaris,” this marks the third mekakushe track featured in the series.
  • “Yuwanamerou” was written and composed by mekakushe, with arrangement by Ryohei Sataka (Hifumi, inc.), who also handled the series’ score. The result is a wistful pop song that delicately expresses the complexity of a woman’s hidden emotions.

    • Product Information

    Digital Single mekakushe “Yuwanamerou” Lyrics/Composition: mekakushe　 Arrangement: Ryohei Sakata (Hifumi Inc.) On streaming websites: linkco.re/BQGVYe3c Official audio: youtu.be/k-4W-ea1bnM

    Mekakushe’s Comment

    To me, love is like the aurora—like a mirage, it shines beautifully because it’s born from loneliness. When I imagined the moment of meeting someone, it felt like a rush of heat sweeping through my heart, creating an aurora. It was something like a solar flare. That feeling is what inspired me as I wrote “Yuwanamerou.”

    Mekakushe’s Profile

    Handling lyrics, composition, vocals, and piano performance by herself, the next-generation singer-songwriter Mekakushe enjoys immense popularity among artists and creators. Starting classical piano at the age of three, she gradually gravitated towards pop music. Her independently produced songs were featured in a Kao Laurier commercial, and she was one of the top artists on the Spotify official playlist “Kirakira Pop Japan” with a total of 3 million plays. She is a promising emerging artist with anticipated future success. With electronica as the foundation in her recordings, her musical style continues to expand, featuring classical solos and band sets in live performances. item.title: New Summer Festival Featuring Performances by 3D Characters from Beloved Japanese Anime and Games Franchises Announced!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • Music festivals are a staple of summer in Japan, and among them, SUMMER SONIC stands out as one of the country’s premier events. Held not only in Japan but also internationally, it has grown into a globally recognized tradition.
  • Now, SUMMER SONIC is launching an all-new festival under the SONIC name, bringing together 3D character models from Japan’s top anime, games, and VTubers for a shared showcase on one stage.
  • In 2025, titles such as The Idolmaster SideM -F＠NTASTIC COMBINATION LIVE-, Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ ALL STAR STAGE -Dramatic Magical Story-, and Hypnosis Mic -Division Rap Battle- HYPED-UP, among others, will come together at Makuhari Messe International Exhibition Halls 9, 10, and 11! Festival-exclusive food and original merchandise will also be available.
  • Each performance will build on past 3D live shows with unique effects and arrangements created just for this event, all delivered in a festival-style format. Don’t miss this special opportunity to see some of Japan’s most exciting titles unite on one unforgettable stage!

    The Idolmaster SideM -F＠NTASTIC COMBINATION LIVE-

    The Idolmaster SideM launched in 2014 as the first male idol producer game in the Idolmaster series. Players take on the role of a producer at the idol agency 315 Production, managing a diverse group of male idols from backgrounds like doctors, students, part-time workers, and self-defense force officers. Through activities like promotions, lessons, and live shows, players nurture the idols, aiming to make them top stars. In August 2017, the app game The Idolmaster SideM LIVE ON ST@GE! was released, followed by The Idolmaster SideM GROWING STARS in October 2021. Currently, the franchise continues its story on the SideM brand page of the Idolmaster Portal Site, with ongoing developments in live shows, music, merchandise, and more. In July 2024, SideM celebrated its 10th anniversary. This event features all 16 units and 49 idols from 315 Production, including High×Joker & Café Parade, FRAME & Mofumofuen, and Jupiter & F-LAGS. item.title: AVIOT Spring/Summer Promo Tour to Visit Five Major North American Anime Conventions!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • AVIOT, operated by Preseed Japan Corporation, which manufactures and sells consumer electronics, is launching its 2025 Spring/Summer Promo Tour with appearances at anime conventions across the United States. At each event, AVIOT will showcase and sell character voice earbuds and collaboration merchandise.

    • About Character Voice Earbuds

    AVIOT’s character voice earbuds are special-edition models created in collaboration with anime, VTubers, and voice actors. Each pair features exclusive designs, packaging, and voice guidance recorded by the featured cast, providing voice prompts for functions like power and battery status. They also include a “Random Voice” feature, which lets you enjoy iconic lines or exclusive phrases only available through the earbuds. Simply touch and hold the right earbud to hear surprise voice clips at any time. Most models offer multiple voice modes, which can be easily switched via the companion app, allowing you to enjoy different characters or personalities with a single pair. Sound tuning is supervised by the original artists or voice actors to capture each title’s unique atmosphere. Select models also include specially drawn artwork*, designed with close attention to detail to reflect the world of your favorite character. *Sound tuning and special artwork may not be available for all models. In addition to fan-focused features, these earbuds also offer high-end specs such as noise cancellation and long battery life, making them a great choice for everyday use. Several collaboration models are based on the TE-V1R, a high-spec base model that has received multiple awards, including the PCMag Excellence Award.

    Exhibition Schedule

    AVIOT will appear at five anime conventions across five North American cities from April to August 2025, as outlined below: April 18–20: Sakura-Con (Completed) May 21–23: Anime Boston (Completed) June 19–21: OffKai EXPO July 3–6: Anime Expo August 23–25: Anime NYC At each convention, AVIOT will exhibit and sell collaboration earbuds and merchandise created in partnership with a variety of IPs, including anime, games, and VTubers. Some products will also be available for hands-on trials at the booth. In addition, exclusive displays will showcase upcoming collaboration models currently available for pre-order, giving you a chance to experience them before anyone else! You can view the products scheduled for sale at the conventions via the link below: shop.aviot.jp/collections/us-convention-items Please note that quantities are limited and items may sell out. Product lineup is subject to change without notice.

    Scenes from past exhibitions

    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Online Store Sales

    Some of the featured products are also available for purchase or pre-order through AVIOT ONLINE MALL or our official Amazon store. AVIOT ONLINE MALL: shop.aviot.jp/collections/us-convention-items Amazon US: amazon.com/stores/page/0DD062F7-4674-4072-9760-099249E3254F

    About AVIOT

    AVIOT, born in 2018 as the original brand of Preseed Japan Corporation, aims to deliver products that convey high-quality Japanese craftsmanship in sound, delicate and beautiful design, and easy-to-use electronic products. In 2023, the brand restarted with the addition of “A Visionary Innovation On Technology” to its name, aiming to be an electronic devices brand that goes beyond the framework of audio-visual products. The vision is to bring innovation through the power of technology and deliver “something that changes your lives” to customers. item.title: TOMY Group to Showcase BEYBLADE X, T-SPARK, and Gacha at Anime Expo 2025!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TOMY Company will exhibit at Anime Expo 2025 (AX2025), North America’s largest anime and manga convention, held in Los Angeles from July 3 to 6. The company will operate three exhibits, each dedicated to a different brand: the BEYBLADE X series, the modern version of “bei-goma” spinning tops; T-SPARK, a hobby label for high-end customers; and the Gacha® capsule toy brand, distributed by T-ARTS Company,Ltd.
  • At the BEYBLADE X booth, the U.S. Open Class of the BEYBLADE X National Tournament will be held on July 5. The winner will qualify for the BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025, scheduled for October in Japan, the birthplace of BEYBLADE.
  • This will mark the second consecutive year that BEYBLADE X is featured at the event, while T-SPARK and Gacha will make their debut appearances. Through these exhibits, TOMY Group will continue to share the excitement of play with fans around the world.

    • About BEYBLADE

    “BEYBLADE” battling tops, debuted in 1999, are a modernized version of traditional Japanese battling tops known as “bei-goma.” Over 520 million units have been shipped cumulatively in more than 80 countries and regions around the world (as of April 2023). Each series has created a craze in many countries across the world including Japan. The fourth generation, BEYBLADE X started in July 2023 in Japan.

    Highlights of BEYBLADE X booth

    → The U.S. Open Class (ages 13 and up) of the BEYBLADE X National Tournament will be held to determine the top blader who will advance to the BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025. → Visitors can enjoy a free-play area and showcases of upcoming products. For more details about the U.S. Open Class of the BEYBLADE X National Tournament, see: takaratomy.co.jp/english/product_release/pdf/p250605_en.pdf

    About T-SPARK

    “T-SPARK” is the unified brand for hobby products for adults developed by TOMY Company, symbolizing innovation and sophisticated adventure. Leveraging TOMY Company’s expertise in “transformation,” “combination” and “articulation” ― the features that have attracted hobby lovers ― T-SPARK offers a diverse and engaging hobby experience. Some of the T-SPARK products are available through the official North American Online store “TOMY PLUS” (us.tomy.com/brand/tomy-plus) operated by TOMY International, Inc. Official T-SPARK website: takaratomy.co.jp/products/tsparkofficial (Japan).

    Highlights of T-SPARK booth

    → Over 30 new items across 8 series on display: DIACLONE original sci-fi character toys / ZOIDS real moving kits (build-it-yourself motorized toys) / REALIZE MODEL action plastic model kits / TOYRISE REALTOY products / SYNERGENEX collaborative items (Macross 7 × Transformers Basara Prime) / Q VILLAGE cute-meets-cool deformed format series / COLLEKAZARO collectible figures / SPARK Fig character figures in both scale and non-scale sizes. → A mini diorama of Q VILLAGE and a photo spot recreating the world of the characters will be on display. → The third Q VILLAGE collaboration, featuring the manga Initial D, will be revealed for the first time. → COLLEKAZARO: A series of 3.75 inches (10 cm) collectible figures. The products in collaboration with the TV anime series My Hero Academia and its official spin-off My Hero Academia: Vigilantes will be on display. → SPARK Fig: The first figure in the series, Princess Ripple from the TV anime Princession Orchestra, will be on display. Product Details: Q VILLAGE, COLLEKAZARO, SPARK Fig takaratomy.co.jp/english/product_release/pdf/p250528_en.pdf https://youtu.be/4xrQvyHJjik

    About Gacha

    Gacha® Capsule toys, which originated in the U.S. and arrived in Japan in 1965, will celebrate their 60th anniversary in Japan in 2025. Under the Gacha brand, T-ARTS Company,Ltd. has expanded these capsule toys across the country, with Gacha machines found in train stations, airports, major shopping malls, and more. Beloved across generations, Gacha has become a familiar part of daily life and is now attracting attention not only within Japan but also internationally as a unique aspect of Japanese culture. Official Gacha website: takaratomy-arts.co.jp/items/gacha (Japan)

    Highlights of Gacha section

    Free Gacha experience. Popular Gacha items from Japan will be available for purchase. Display of PERIHAPI!, a blind box figure series born from the Gacha brand, with first-ever appearance of products from Haikyu!! and Piapro Characters. Photo spot where visitors can step inside a giant Gacha machine.

    Event Overview

    Event Overview Date: July 3 – July 6, 2025 (Pacific Daylight Time) Venue: Los Angeles Convention Center Booth Numbers: ENTERTAINMENT HALL – E-25 (BEYBLADE X), E-10 (T-SPARK, Gacha, PERIHAPI!) AX2025 Official Website: anime-expo.org/ax

item.title: AVIOT to Open Pre-Orders for KizunaAI Collaboration True Wireless Earbuds!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • AVIOT, operated by Preseed Japan Corporation, which manufactures and sells consumer electronics, opened pre-orders for the TE-V1R-KZN true wireless earbuds, a collaboration model with KizunaAI, on April 28. Based on the TE-V1R, this special edition features design and sound tuning fully supervised by KizunaAI, packaging with brand-new visuals, and newly recorded voice lines in Japanese and English.
  • Based on the latest model in AVIOT’s hit V series, which has sold approximately 170,000 units*, the TE-V1R-KZN is a special edition packed with the unique charm of KizunaAI, who resumed activities in February.
  • KizunaAI (“Kizuna” means “bond” or “connection” in Japanese) is a virtual being and artist who works under the theme, “I still want to connect with you and get to know you.” This collaboration model features earbuds with a design overseen by KizunaAI herself and sound tuning optimized to highlight the full appeal of her singing voice. The packaging showcases a brand-new visual by champi. In addition to newly recorded voice guidance for power and connection status, the earbuds include a “random voice” feature that allows you to listen to special voice lines anytime you like. With the ability to switch between Japanese and English voice modes, these earbuds are a perfect match for an AI who connects with people around the world.
  • KizunaAI introduced the product herself during a special listening party on April 29. Don’t miss it!

    • Product Characteristics

    Base Model The TE-V1R is the latest model in AVIOT’s popular V series, which has sold approximately 170,000 units*. The earbuds offer an ultra-long battery life of 19 hours (62 hours with the charging case) and Adaptive Hybrid Noise Canceling, which automatically adjusts the noise reduction strength based on the surrounding environment. They also feature the new Hybrid Dual Driver 2.0 for enhanced sound quality, LDAC™ support for high-resolution playback, and wireless charging functionality, making them a high-grade model that perfectly balances sound quality and functionality. *As of the end of January 2025 Special Voice Lines The voice guidance for notifications such as power status has been newly recorded specifically for this model, with KizunaAI speaking to you as if she’s right there! It also features a “random voice” function that lets you hear lines from KizunaAI anytime you like. As is fitting of an AI who connects with people around the world, the earbuds come with both Japanese and English modes.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Voice line samples are available on the product page: aviot.jp/product/te-v1r-kzn Special Design The off-white and soft pink color scheme captures KizunaAI’s signature style, giving the design a calm and refined feel. The charging case features a logo symbolizing her reactivation, while the earbuds themselves are adorned with her iconic emblem. The design was created to have a timeless appeal, making it easy to pair with any outfit or setting.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Packaging The packaging features a brand-new visual created by the illustrator champi, capturing a rare moment of KizunaAI enjoying music through the earbuds. This special design is exclusive to the collaboration and even looks great displayed on its own.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]
    Special Tuning With full supervision from KizunaAI, the earbuds feature two sound modes that can be switched anytime via the app: Music Mode, specially tuned to bring out the full charm of KizunaAI’s singing voice, and Streaming Mode, designed to deliver clearer audio when watching streams.

    Product Information

    TE-V1R-KZN Price: ¥18,700 (incl. tax) Expected Delivery Date: July 2025 or later Available at: AVIOT ONLINE MALL shop.aviot.jp/products/te-v1r-kzn AMAZON amazon.com/dp/B0F6MJTGGX → Basic Specifications ・Driver: Hybrid type with φ10mm dynamic and balanced armature drivers ・Microphone for calls: MEMS microphone ・Battery capacity: Earbud single ear 85mAh / Case 600mAh ・Talk time*: Up to 9 hours ・Playback time*: Up to 19 hours (with charging case: up to 62 hours) ・Earbud charging time: Approximately 1.5 hours ・Charging port: USB Type-C ・Water resistance level**: Equivalent to IPX4 ・Weight: Earbud single ear approximately 6.5g ・Other features: Multipoint support (up to 2 devices), single ear usage, earbuds can be individually turned on or off, fast charging (up to 120 minutes of playback with a 10-minute charge), wireless charging → Accessories ・Silicone earpieces (1 pair each in sizes S/M/L) ・USB Type-C cable ・User manual → Bluetooth Specifications ・Supported codecs: SBC, AAC, LDAC ・Supported profiles: A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, HSP ・Bluetooth version: 5.3 ・Number of Bluetooth multi-pairing registrable devices: 8 *Exact time may vary depending on your usage environment **Earbuds only

    KizunaAI Profile

    A virtual being and artist who works under the theme, “I still want to connect with you and get to know you.” She debuted in 2016 as a pioneer of virtual YouTubers and quickly expanded her activities through her wide range of talents. After three years of sleep, she resumed her activities on February 26, 2025, and is now seeking new forms of expression through music. Before her hiatus, she focused on Japanese internet dance music. In this new chapter, while staying true to those roots, she blends indie band sounds and J-pop influences to introduce a fresh take on J-pop to the world.

item.title: WurtS to Perform “Doukashiteru” as Ending Theme for DAN DA DAN Season 2. New Trailer Featuring the Song Out Now!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • It has been announced that WurtS will perform “Doukashiteru,” the brand-new ending theme for the second season of the TV anime DAN DA DAN!
  • DAN DA DAN is a hit manga by Yukinobu Tatsu, currently serialized in Shueisha’s manga app Shonen Jump+ (updated every Tuesday), with over 10 million copies in circulation. The story follows Momo Ayase, a high school girl born into a family of spirit mediums, and her classmate Okarun Takakura, an occult fanatic, as they take on supernatural threats in this thrilling blend of occult battles and youthful adventure.
  • “Doukashiteru” is featured in the newly released Friendship & Love trailer. The second season, following the first season that aired from October to December 2024, is set to begin soon.
    • https://youtu.be/t-ifCiMRt6Y

    Comment From WurtS

    I’m WurtS, and I’m performing the ending theme for the DAN DA DAN anime. As a huge fan of both the manga and the anime, I’m truly honored to be part of this project. In this crazy world where various life forms suddenly appear, I wanted to capture the characters’ complicated feelings—awkward but full of longing. We’ve packed all that excitement and heart-throbbing emotion into this wonderful song. Thank you so much, and I hope you enjoy it.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    WurtS's Profile

    Launched in 2021, WurtS is a 21st-century-born solo artist who self-produces everything, from lyrics, composition, and arrangement to artwork and visuals. His music, centered on dance, is constantly evolving into a unique style of pop that blends genres such as rock, hip-hop, soul, and more. −WurtS INFORMATION− Official Website: wurts.jp X: x.com/wurts2021 Instagram: instagram.com/wurts2021 TikTok: tiktok.com/@nia_n_ YouTube Channel: youtube.com/@wurts2021

item.title: SANDA's World Premiere Event With Paru Itagaki Set for Anime Expo!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • SANDA is a manga by Paru Itagaki, creator of BEASTARS, which won the Grand Prize at the 2018 Manga Taisho along with three other major manga awards. Set in a near-future Japan where extreme measures are taken to protect children amid a drastic population decline, the story depicts an unconventional Santa Claus hero in an action-packed tale. The anime adaptation is produced by Science SARU, the studio behind DAN DA DAN and Scott Pilgrim Takes Off. It is set to premiere in Japan on October 3, 2025, with a world premiere also confirmed for Anime Expo.
  • Alongside the broadcast date announcement, the second teaser trailer has been released. It showcases a world shaped by extreme overprotection amid a super-declining birthrate, focusing on the classmates of protagonist Kazushige Sanda (voiced by Ayumu Murase) at Daikoku Welfare Academy. How is Santa Claus treated in a Japan where children have almost disappeared? And how will Sanda’s interactions with classmates like Fuyumura develop? Stay tuned for more updates!
  • New Characters and Voice Cast Revealed, with Comments! Alongside the release of Teaser PV #2, several new characters have been revealed! Umeka Shoji voices Shiori Fuyumura, who discovers Sanda’s identity and sets out to save her missing best friend. Her friend Ichie Ono is played by Anna Nagase. Yuuki Shin voices Hitoshi Amaya, Sanda’s roommate, and Misato Matsuoka plays Nico Kazao, Sanda’s fiancée. Comments from the cast have also been released!
  • https://youtu.be/X2VRYMWbaes

    SANDA Joins Anime Expo!

    SANDA will be featured at Anime Expo 2025, North America’s largest anime and Japanese pop culture event, held at the Los Angeles Convention Center from July 3 to 6. On July 4, a world premiere event will take place, with author Paru Itagaki, director Tomohisa Shimoyama, and Science SARU producer Kohei Sakita in attendance. The event will include a live drawing session by Itagaki and a screening of Episode 1 of the SANDA anime. For more information, please check Anime Expo’s official social media channels.

    Anime Expo 2025 Overview

    Dates: July 3 (Thu) – July 6 (Sun), 2025 Venue: Los Angeles Convention Center Official Website: anime-expo.org Official X: x.com/animeexpo Official Instagram: instagram.com/animeexpo Official Facebook: facebook.com/animeexpo

    SANDA event at Anime Expo 2025

    Date: July 4 (Fri) Time: 12:30 PM – 1:50 PM Location: JW Platinum Ballroom Panelists: Paru Itagaki (author), Tomohisa Shimoyama (director), Kohei Sakita (producer) The event will include: ・Live drawing by Paru Itagaki ・World premiere of the first episode of the TV anime SANDA ・Commentary on highlighted scenes from episode #1 and discussion ・Q&A with the panelists ・Comment video by Ayumu Murase (who plays Sanda) ・Free give away for visitors: SANDA Towel (Tenugui style) Official X (formerly Twitter): x.com/sanda_anime Official Website: sanda.red
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Voice Cast of Sanda’s Classmates Revealed!

    Shiori Fuyumura (Voiced by Umeka Shoji)

    A 14-year-old classmate of Sanda who stands over 182 cm tall. She seeks help from Santa Claus to find her friend Ono, who suddenly went missing. To break the curse and revive the sealed Santa, she threatens Sanda with a deadly blade. Comment 1. How did you feel when you were cast as Fuyumura in SANDA? And what message do you have for fans looking forward to the series? Meeting Shiori Fuyumura during the audition was such a powerful experience that it feels like she’s become a constant presence in my life. I poured everything I have into this role. I’d be thrilled if SANDA reaches a wide audience. 2. Since this is an action series featuring Santa Claus, is there anything you’d want to ask him for? A liver so strong that it can handle any alcohol.

    Ichie Ono (Voiced by Anna Nagase)

    A classmate of Sanda and best friend of Fuyumura. She suddenly disappeared from their class, and her whereabouts remain unknown. The school considers her dead, but Fuyumura is determined to search for her with Santa Claus’ help. Comment 1. How did you feel when you were cast as Ono in SANDA? And what message do you have for fans looking forward to the series? Ono was a role that really challenged me. I struggled a lot while developing the character, and I constantly felt a sense of anxiety and tightness in my chest. I hope that feeling comes through in Ono’s portrayal. Please look forward to the broadcast! 2. Since this is an action series featuring Santa Claus, is there anything you’d want to ask him for? When I was a kid, I was always the one receiving presents, so this time, I’d like to give something back. Maybe I could help out? Like riding in the sleigh with Santa and delivering presents around town! That sounds like fun.

    Hitoshi Amaya (Voiced by Yuuki Shin)

    Sanda’s roommate, also known as “Prince Amaya.” He is one of the few who know Santa Claus’ secret and wants him to return to fulfill an important wish. Comment 1. How did you feel when you were cast as Amaya in SANDA? And what message do you have for fans looking forward to the series? I’m really excited to be voicing Amaya in SANDA. I enjoyed bringing out his mysterious charm through my performance. This story really makes you reflect on what it means to be an adult. It’s a wonderful series, so please be sure to watch it! 2. Since this is an action series featuring Santa Claus, is there anything you’d want to ask him for? I’d love to ask Santa Claus for a Nintendo Switch 2. Even if I don’t get one, just a chance to win the pre-order lottery would be great. I’ve been good, so please! I’d like to play racing games on it!

    Nico Kazao (Voiced by Misato Matsuoka)

    Sanda’s fiancée, chosen by the country from birth. She’s a realist who wants to rebel a little before becoming a “responsible adult.” She always acts freely and often swears. Comment 1. How did you feel when you were cast as Nico in SANDA? And what message do you have for fans looking forward to the series? When I first learned about Nico, I was deeply captivated by her complete freedom from any constraints. She might be someone who truly understands the preciousness of the present moment. I’m genuinely happy to be able to bring her to life! Please watch as these lovable characters struggle and grow together. I poured my heart into this role and had a great time. Thank you for your support! 2. Since this is an action series featuring Santa Claus, is there anything you’d want to ask him for? I love eggplant, so I’d want lots of dishes like deep-fried eggplant soaked in light dashi and mapo eggplant!

    TV Anime SANDA Overview

    Broadcast begins October 3, 2025 in Japan Official X (formerly Twitter): x.com/sanda_anime Official website: sanda.red

    Cast

    Kazushige Sanda: Ayumu Murase Santa Claus: Hiroki Touchi Shiori Fuyumura: Umeka Shoji Ichie Ono: Anna Nagase Hitoshi Amaya: Yuuki Shin Nico Kazao: Misato Matsuoka Staff Original: “SANDA” by Paru Itagaki (Akita Shoten / Shonen Champion Comics) Director: Tomohisa Shimoyama Script: Kimiko Ueno Music: Tomoyuki Tanaka (FPM) Character Design: Masamichi Ishiyama Animation Production: Science SARU

item.title: BEYBLADE X National Tournament (Ages +13) Set for July 5 at AX2025 in Los Angeles! Winner Advances to the World Championships in October!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • TOMY Company has announced that it will hold the U.S. Open Class (ages 13 and up) tournament for the “BEYBLADE X” series, the modern version of “bei-goma” spinning tops, under the title “BEYBLADE X National Tournament.” The event will take place on July 5 (Sat) at the BEYBLADE X booth during Anime Expo® 2025 (AX2025), North America’s largest anime and manga convention held in Los Angeles. (*1)
  • The winner of this tournament will advance to represent the United States at the BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025, scheduled for October in Japan, the birthplace of BEYBLADE. This event promises high-stakes battles, highlighting the thrill of GEAR SPORTS for both players and spectators alike.
  • Additionally, from July 3 to July 6, the BEYBLADE X booth (Booth No.: ENTERTAINMENT HALL – E-25) will feature a free-play area and showcases of upcoming products.

    • BEYBLADE X National Tournament (US Open Class)

    Date: Saturday, July 5, 2025 Time: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Pacific Daylight Time) Location: Los Angeles Convention Center Booth Number: ENTERTAINMENT HALL - E-25 Eligibility: Ages 13 and up Registration: First-come, first-served at the booth on the day of the event. Registration closes once capacity (128 participants) is reached. Official Website: beyblade.com/worldchampionship2025

    Message from Masahiko Yamazaki, Head of Global Beyblade Business at TOMY Company

    We are thrilled to hold the tournament in Los Angeles, the entertainment capital of the world, to determine the top blader, who will advance to the BEYBLADE X WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP 2025. On the day of the tournament, the TOMY Company Beyblade development team will also come from Japan to offer their support. Just like in Japan, we’re eagerly looking forward to intense Bey battles in the U.S.

    About BEYBLADE

    Born in 1999, the BEYBLADE brand originated in Japan and has been enjoyed globally across generations for over 25 years. The fourth generation, BEYBLADE X, launched in July 2023, has surpassed 30 million units shipped worldwide (including 79 regions in Asia, North America, and Europe) as of April 2025, with intense battles taking place around the globe. In the United States, BEYBLADE is sold at major retailers such as Walmart and Target, the largest e-commerce company Amazon, and the leading game retailer GameStop. In the Battling Toys category, Beyblade became the No.1 property in over 11 countries and regions, including the U.S., in CY2024. (*2) Season 2 of the BEYBLADE X anime series is set to air in North America starting summer 2025, further fueling the excitement. In addition to the U.S. National Tournament, there will be a free play area open to everyone. Participants can bring their own Beyblades, while beginners can borrow Beyblades and get help learning how to play. In addition, the booth will feature a large screen showing scenes from the TV anime and photo spots designed for anime fans to enjoy. (*1) The Regular Class (ages 6 to 12) of the U.S. National Tournament is scheduled to be held from June to August 2025 across the United States. (*2) Source: Beyblades was the No.1 property within Battling Toys class in the toy markets of USA, Canada, Mexico, U.K., France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Belgium, Holland and Australia in CY2024 in terms of dollar volume according to Circana, LLC. “BEYBLADE” battling tops, debuted in 1999, are a modernized version of traditional Japanese battling tops known as “bei-goma.” Over 520 million units have been shipped cumulatively in more than 80 countries and regions around the world (as of April 2023). Each series has created a craze in many countries across the world including Japan. The fourth generation, BEYBLADE X started in July 2023 in Japan. BEYBLADE X Official websites beyblade.takaratomy.co.jp (Japan) takaratomyasia.com/beybladex/index (Asia) Company’s official website: takaratomy.co.jp/english To stay in the loop on these tournaments and other updates around the World Championship, fans can go to beyblade.com for more information. Fans can also stay informed by following @officialbeyblade on Instagram, @beyblade_official on TikTok, @x_beyblade on X, and on BEYBLADE Official YouTube Channels.

item.title: [Honey's Anime Interview] Celebrating TRUE's 10th Anniversary!
item.content:encoded:
Miho Karasawa, who also goes by the stage name TRUE, has just released her 10th anniversary album titled "TRUE the BEST" on February 26 (her debut date)! You may know her for her passionate vocal style and straightforward lyrics in theme songs for anime series like Buddy Complex, Gargantia on the Verdurous Planet, Maria the Virgin Witch, Sound! Euphonium, and many others. Although she has been active as an artist since 2000, she debuted under the name TRUE in 2014, quickly becoming a powerhouse singer, flawlessly performing numerous opening and ending themes each anime season. We had the lovely opportunity to interview TRUE once more, to talk about the future and reflect on these ten years full of hits and challenges.

TRUE
Honey-Chan
Interview with TRUE
[gray-hex-decoration]
It’s been a year since our last conversation, and we're so happy to be chatting with you again! So, you recently released an anniversary album, packed with 30 songs and numerous hits. Was it challenging to select and arrange the tracks for this album? And if you had to choose, which song would you say is your favorite?
This release includes singles, lead tracks from albums, and key songs that represent my musical journey over the past ten years. With the exception of the first and last tracks, the songs are arranged in the order they were released. It starts with the first track, “TRUE,” and ends with “DelighT,” with the capital T at the end representing the T in TRUE. I wanted it to begin and end with TRUE, which is how the tracklist took shape. Every song holds a special meaning to me, so it’s hard to pick just one favorite.
The Limited First Edition includes a Blu-ray featuring two performances: TRUE Live Sound! vol.6 Encount, held at NHK Hall, and Sayonara Nakano Sunplaza Music Festival: TRUE Live Sound! vol.7 Ensemble, held at Nakano Sunplaza, both from 2023. Can you share any memorable anecdotes or special moments from these performances?
For me, live performances are life itself. I’m truly grateful to have these moments recorded. I hope that even those who couldn’t be there can still feel the passion of the shows through the Blu-ray.
https://youtu.be/x6fUsfL8UKw
And how about your most recent live event, TRUE 10th Anniversary Live Sound! Final Shuutaisei at Zepp DiverCity this January? How was that experience?
That show was the perfect way to wrap up my 10th anniversary. It was my first time performing in a large live house, and the audience’s energy was even greater than I had imagined. I felt that it was a meaningful milestone not just for me, but for the fans as well, marking the end of a decade. Throughout the anniversary year, I held various types of live shows, and I plan to use what I gained from those experiences moving forward.
Now it's time to celebrate your first decade as an artist, but given everything you've accomplished so far, we imagine you're already planning your next steps. Are you currently working on any new songs or projects to be released soon?
Yes, I’m trying various new things and plan to put even more effort into live performances both in Japan and overseas. Since last year, I’ve been doing joint live shows with other artists, and through these interactions, I’m working to expand my musical range. Another goal for the future is to create a theme song for a tokusatsu anime. I will continue my music activities, dreaming of the day that wish comes true.
In May, you performed three new shows in Japan as part of your TRUE Live Tour PLAY! vol.1 -ReCoda-. How did you prepare for these events?
This time, I did my very first hall tour. I felt like I received so many gifts and warm congratulations for my 10th anniversary, and so many people came out to celebrate with me at my shows. I’m going to use all that support as fuel to make each live performance a success from this 11th year onward, which will help me grow even more. It’s not exactly going back to my roots, but I’m planning to perform with the same band lineup as my very first live, carefully arranging each song to deliver it thoughtfully. In June, I’m also holding my first-ever Asia tour. It’s a new challenge to see how much I can convey beyond borders and language barriers. I’ll do my best!
We'll be looking forward to this! And to close our interview, could you share a message for our readers, many of whom have followed our previous interviews and are passionate about your music?
Thank you always for your support. I’m truly grateful to receive encouragement from people in many countries through social media. Your words keep me motivated. From now on, as an anisong singer, I will continue doing my best to share Japanese anime culture and anisong culture with all of you. I look forward to the day we can meet someday.
We've been listening to this new album since release day, and it brings back so many memories! At Honey’s Anime, we’re deeply passionate about TRUE’s music and have had the pleasure of witnessing her incredible growth over the years. If you’re new to her work and eager to discover more, be sure to check her out on social media.
Connect with TRUE Streaming link: lnk.to/LACM-24407d Official Site: true-singer.com/ X (Twitter): x.com/miho_karasawa Instagram: instagram.com/miho_karasawa YouTube channel: youtube.com/@TRUEOfficialChannel

item.title: Japanese Traditional Craft x The Ghost in the Shell: “TechnoByobu: TB-02” — An Art Piece That Transcends Time and Space Coming in 2026 from U/M/A/A
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • U/M/A/A has announced that it will release a second installment of “TechnoByobu,” an art piece that combines the spirit of techno with the traditional Japanese craft of folding screens, in 2026. This new series, titled “TB-02: The Ghost in the Shell,” is based on Shirow Masamune’s legendary cyberpunk series The Ghost in the Shell.
  • “TechnoByobu” is an art piece of a new era that reimagines the works of internationally and domestically acclaimed artists as folding screens made from wafer-thin golden brass leaves, a craft that has been handed down in Japan for over 500 years. The artworks, vividly depicted in vibrant colors on folding screens made entirely of golden brass leaf, have attracted attention as a fusion of traditional and modern art. The first piece, “TB-01: Electronic Fan Girl,” which was inspired by the album artwork of YMO (Yellow Magic Orchestra), generated significant buzz.
  • “TB-02: The Ghost in the Shell,” based on the world-famous science fiction work The Ghost in the Shell (Shirow Masamune/Kodansha), utilizes the physical medium of a folding screen with cybernetic visuals, creating a next-generation visual that merges past and future.
  • Scheduled for release in 2026 as part of a series themed around traditional Japanese elegance, the first work in the series boldly features Motoko Kusanagi and the Fuchikoma from Shirow Masamune’s original 1991 manga, on a golden brass leaf background.
  • Prior to the release, U/M/A/A will unveil the first prototype of the series at Design Shanghai 2025 (designshanghai.com) to be held in Shanghai, China, from June 4, 2025.

    • TechnoByobu Second Installment TB-02: The Ghost in the Shell

    ️TechnoByobu Second Installment

    Number: TB-02 Title: The Ghost in the Shell Artist: Shirow Masamune

    Product Overview

    TechnoByobu Official Website: technobyobu.jp Release Date: Scheduled for 2026 This piece will be offered as a limited edition, accompanied by a unique serial number. If you are considering a purchase, please register through the Customer Service form on the official website. Priority information will be sent to registered customers. Customer Service form: technobyobu.jp/cs Size: Height: 59.05 inches (1,500 mm) Width: 55.12 inches (1,400 mm) Weight: 8.8 pounds (4 kg) Material: Golden Brass Leaf Printing Method: Archival Pigment Print Technique: Kasane Graphica Multi-Layered Pigment Transfer Technique Price: TBD Series Concept: A lineup of distinct pieces infused with the elegance and spirit of Japan.

    What is TechnoByobu?

    TechnoByobu’s “techno” originates from the Greek word téchnē, meaning art, technique, or skill. It embodies more than just practical know-how; it’s a philosophical concept that encompasses the intelligence and creativity behind craftsmanship, as well as the futuristic expression of electronic music. Rooted in this background, “techno” is not only the origin of the word “technology” but also a layered term that blends cultural and artistic innovation. Based on this philosophy, TechnoByobu is composed of three elements: ・Artwork that evokes futurism (art) ・Byobu (folding screens), a traditional Japanese craft kept alive by artisans (skill) ・Digital certificates guaranteed by technology (technique) By overlapping these elements, TechnoByobu culminates as an art piece that expresses the multifaceted nature of “Techno.” Moving forward, it will continue to explore new possibilities of expression in collaboration with diverse talents both in Japan and abroad.

    About The Ghost in the Shell

    “The Ghost in the Shell” is a science fiction manga series written by manga artist Shirow Masamune, which began serialization in 1989, in Kodansha’s “Young Magazine Pirate Edition.” The story revolves around Motoko Kusanagi, a full-body cyborg with exceptional skill in both cyber and conventional warfare. With the rank of Major, she leads the aggressive unit “Shell Squad” as they confront highly intricate and sinister crimes. With its realistic art style, the series’ narrative explores the fusion of humans and technology, delving into cyberpunk elements and philosophical themes, while deeply examining topics such as personal identity. The series has been expanded into various forms including theatrical and TV animations, as well as games. Each of these adaptations offers its own unique story, interpretations, and expressions, distinct from the original manga.

    Unveiling of the prototype at Design Shanghai — the World’s First Public Exhibition

    Design Shanghai is one of the world’s most prestigious international design events and a driving force in the new frontier-breaking Chinese design world. In 2024, they invited more than 600 brands from 40 countries worldwide to exhibit new products and hold specially organized events. At this year’s 2025 Design Shanghai, starting June 4, TechnoByobu’s second installment, “TB-02: The Ghost in the Shell,” will be unveiled to the world for the very first time. During the exhibition, visitors will have the opportunity to see the prototype up close.
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    Exhibition Information

    Design Shanghai 2025 Date: June 4th-7th, 2025 Venue: Shanghai Expo Hall 3 “Beyond Craft Japan” 3F81 designshanghai.com

    About Rekiseisha

    In its founding year of 1905, Rekiseisha developed a groundbreaking scientific technique that had never been seen before: foil-pressed paper using brass leaf that was just as beautiful as the traditional gold foil (hon-kinpaku) but far more resistant to discoloration over time. This innovative manufacturing method has earned Rekiseisha international acclaim, with its foil products used not only by the Imperial Hotel, the Imperial Household Agency, and Nishi Honganji Temple, but also by global luxury brands such as CHANEL and GUCCI. HP：rekiseisha.com

    About U/M/A/A Inc. (United Music And Arts) (Planning, Production, Sales)

    U/M/A/A Inc. is a next-generation record label dedicated to bridging music and art—including media art, fashion, anime, games, manga, and technology—across Japan and the rest of the world. The label curates and delivers high-quality music that spans a wide range of genres, from club and electronic music to internet-driven styles such as Vocaloid and anime songs. Founded by Masakazu “Hiro” Hiroishi—formerly of the legendary Alfa Records, the company that brought Yellow Magic Orchestra (YMO) to global prominence in the late 1970s—U/M/A/A Inc. was established with the mission of carrying forward YMO’s pioneering spirit and the innovation of techno-pop into the modern age. In that spirit, U/M/A/A Inc. presents TechnoByobu—a project that embodies the fusion of tradition, technology, and art. Contact: U/M/A/A Inc. info@technobyobu.jp umaa.net

    Cat. Number：TB-01 Title: Electronic Fan Girl Licensed by ©2022 Lou Beach through ALFA Music, Inc. item.title: ASH and MindaRyn Announced as Theme Song Artists for Ultraman Omega!
item.content:encoded:
[sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

[en]What You Need to Know: [/en][es]Lo que necesitas saber: [/es]

  • The Ultraman series is beloved across generations, and as its 60th anniversary approaches, the latest installment is poised to launch worldwide through broadcast and streaming. The tokusatsu drama Ultraman Omega will debut on July 5, 2025, in Japan.
  • It was announced today that the opening theme, “BRIGHT EYES,” will be performed by ASH, while the ending theme, “Missing Link,” will be performed by MindaRyn, with a rap by ASH.
  • Both songs will be released as a CD single on July 21, 2025. The product will include a limited-edition soft vinyl figure of Ultraman Omega Transformation Glow Color Ver. from the Ultra Hero Series.

    • Opening Theme

    BRIGHT EYES Vocals: ASH Lyrics: Yohei Matsui; Composition: NARASAKI; Arrangement: Kazuya Nishioka
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    ASH's Comment

    Hello, this is ASH. I’m honored to be performing the opening theme and contributing the rap part to the ending theme for Ultraman Omega. It truly feels like a dream to be involved with Ultraman, a series I’ve loved since childhood. I wish I could go back and tell my younger self—the one who used to send letters to Ultraman! Both “BRIGHT EYES” and “Missing Link” are songs about the importance of believing in yourself. I hope these songs plant a seed of courage in your heart.

    Profile

    A powerhouse rock singer who captivates fans with his distinctive voice and magnetic charisma. As the frontman of ASH DA HERO—hailed as “the ultimate rock band of the Reiwa era”—ASH leads the rock scene with a bold, genre-blending style rooted in rock, punk, and hip-hop. With a deep passion for anime and manga culture, he garnered major attention through his collaboration with the TV anime Blue Lock. In 2025, he embarked on his first world tour, further solidifying his presence on the global stage.

    Ending Theme

    Missing Link Vocals: MindaRyn feat. ASH Lyrics: Yohei Matsui, ASH; Composition/Arrangement: thug
    [sourceLink asin="" asin_jp="" cdj_product_id="" text="" url="" ]

    MinaRyn's Comment

    I’m truly moved to once again be performing an ending theme for the Ultraman series! I sang with all my heart to capture the power and spirit of Ultraman Omega. I hope Omega’s determination to move forward without losing hope in the face of any challenge will resonate with people around the world. It’s a project I’m deeply proud to be part of. Please enjoy the ending theme, performed by ASH and me!

    Profile

    Originally from Thailand, MindaRyn was exposed to Japanese culture and anime from a young age and eventually relocated to Japan to pursue a career as an anime song singer. She is a trilingual artist fluent in Thai, Japanese, and English. In November 2020, she made her artist debut under Lantis with the ending theme “BLUE ROSE knows” for the TV anime By the Grace of the Gods. Since then, she has performed theme songs for numerous anime and tokusatsu series, including Ultraman Blazar, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, and Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest.

    Product Information

    Ultraman Opening OP/ED Theme: BRIGHT EYES/Missing Link (with soft vinyl figure) Artists: ASH/MindaRyn feat. ASH Release date: July 21, 2025 Product No.: LACM-34698 Price: ¥3,850 (incl. tax) Includes: Ultra Hero Series Ultraman Omega Transformation Glow Color Ver. soft vinyl figure *This product will be unavailable once production reaches its limit. Tracklist: 1. BRIGHT EYES Vocals: ASH Lyrics: Yohei Matsui Composition: NARASAKI Arrangement: Kazuya Nishioka 2. Missing Link Vocals: MindaRyn feat.
